chunks.title: Ashtanga Hridaya — Classical Masanumasika Principles & Milk Regimen
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: मासे प्रथमे मधुरशीतं च पयः पिबेत्। द्वितीये मधुरासिद्धम्। तृतीये मधुसर्पिर्भ्याम्। चतुर्थे नवनीतेन। पञ्चमे सर्पिषा युतम्। षष्ठे गोक्षुरसिद्धेन। सप्तमे पृथक्पर्ण्यादिना। अष्टमे यवागूं सर्पिष्मतीम्। नवमेऽनुवासनपिचुक्रियाम्॥
chunks.transliteration: māse prathame madhuraśītaṁ ca payaḥ pibet | dvitīye madhurāsiddham | tṛtīye madhusarpirbhyām | caturthe navanītena | pañcame sarpiṣā yutam | ṣaṣṭhe gokṣurasiddhena | saptame pṛthakparṇyādinā | aṣṭame yavāgūṁ sarpiṣmatīm | navame'nuvāsanapicukriyām ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: वाग्भट ने अष्टाङ्ग हृदय में नौ महीनों के लिए सरल एवं स्पष्ट क्षीर परिचर्या का विधान किया है: प्रथम मास शीतल मधुर दूध; द्वितीय मास मधुर गण सिद्ध दूध; तृतीय मास मधु व घृत युक्त; चतुर्थ मास मक्खन (नवनीत); पञ्चम मास घृत युक्त; षष्ठ मास गोक्षुर सिद्ध घृत/दूध (शोथ नाशक); सप्तम मास पृथक्पर्ण्यादि सिद्ध; अष्टम मास घृतयुक्त क्षीर-यवागु; और नवम मास में अनुवासन बस्ति तथा योनि पिचु।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Acharya Vagbhata condenses the essential Masanumasika Paricharya into a sequential medicated milk and lipid protocol: Month 1 cold sweet milk; Month 2 Madhura Gana medicated milk; Month 3 milk with honey and ghee (unequal); Month 4 milk with fresh butter (Navanita); Month 5 milk with cow's ghee; Month 6 Gokshura-medicated ghee/milk (diuretic protection against pedal edema); Month 7 Prithakparnyadi-medicated ghee; Month 8 Ksheera-Yavagu with ghee; Month 9 Anuvasana Basti and Bala Taila Yoni Pichu.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 9 & 10 (Maternal Nutrition & ANC Care): Matches progressive calcium (1200 mg/day), essential fatty acids (DHA/EPA for fetal neurodevelopment), and fluid intake through the three trimesters, culminating in cervical preparation in late pregnancy.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Cow's milk (Godugdha) has ten properties identical to Ojas (Oja-Samana Gunas). It directly fortifies Rasa Dhatu, supports placental transfer, and prevents maternal osteopenia and dehydration.
red_flags: Sudden excessive weight gain (>1 kg/week in 2nd/3rd trimester)
Generalized edema involving hands and face
Severe epigastric pain radiating to back

chunks.sanskrit: मासे प्रथमे पयः सात्म्यं मधुरशीतद्रवभूयिष्ठम्
chunks.iast: māse prathame payaḥ sātmyaṃ madhuraśītadravabhūyiṣṭham
chunks.hindi: पहले माह में सात्म्य दूध तथा मधुर-शीत-द्रव आहार दें।
chunks.english: 1st month: wholesome milk and a mainly sweet-cold-liquid diet. Pathya: Sweet, cold & liquid-predominant diet (Madhura-Sheeta-Drava); Boiled-cooled milk, Laja-manda (puffed-rice water), coconut water; Shashtika / old rice, moong soup, ghee in small amount. Ksheera/Ghrita: Sheeta Ksheera (Anupaskrita) — Plain cow's milk, boiled then cooled, 150–200 ml in sips through the day as per Satmya. Not medicated, not heavy. Rationale: Early Kalala is delicate; cold-sweet-liquid food supports Rasa Dhatu and prevents Pitta-Vata aggravation and nausea, protecting implantation.
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 1–4 · Fertilisation, implantation & booking: Fertilisation in the ampulla, implantation on day 6–7, hCG detectable ~8–10 days post-ovulation; UPT positive at missed period. Confirm pregnancy, calculate EDD (Naegele: LMP + 9 months + 7 days), start folic acid 400 mcg (5 mg in high-risk), book ANC early, avoid teratogens (alcohol, tobacco, unsupervised drugs, radiation).
red_flags: Bleeding PV with lower-abdominal pain (threatened abortion / ectopic)
Severe one-sided pelvic pain or shoulder-tip pain
Persistent vomiting with inability to retain fluids
tags: apathya: Fasting or long gaps between meals; Spicy, sour, fried and fermented food

plan.fetal: Samurchchhita (fertilised) Kalala — an unmanifest, jelly-like embryo (Khetabhuta, Avyakta-vigraha). Atma, Manas and the Panchamahabhuta join the Shukra-Shonita.

ksheera.name: Sheeta Ksheera (Anupaskrita)
ksheera.detail: Plain cow's milk, boiled then cooled, 150–200 ml in sips through the day as per Satmya. Not medicated, not heavy.

pathya: Sweet, cold & liquid-predominant diet (Madhura-Sheeta-Drava)
Boiled-cooled milk, Laja-manda (puffed-rice water), coconut water
Shashtika / old rice, moong soup, ghee in small amount
Soaked raisins (Draksha) 5–6, dates 2, fennel-water
Fresh seasonal fruit — pomegranate, sweet orange, banana
Folic acid per doctor (400 mcg–5 mg)
avoid: Fasting or long gaps between meals
Spicy, sour, fried and fermented food
Heavy lifting, long travel, jerky vehicles
Papaya (raw), excess sesame, ajwain, fenugreek, pineapple
plan.rationale: Early Kalala is delicate; cold-sweet-liquid food supports Rasa Dhatu and prevents Pitta-Vata aggravation and nausea, protecting implantation.
plan.tip: For morning nausea (Chhardi): Laja-manda with a little honey & elaichi, dry toast, small frequent meals.

chunks.sanskrit: चतुर्थे क्षीरनवनीतम् अश्नीयात्
chunks.iast: caturthe kṣīranavanītam aśnīyāt
chunks.hindi: चौथे माह में क्षीर-नवनीत का सेवन।
chunks.english: 4th month: milk with fresh butter; fulfil Dauhrida (cravings) wholesomely. Pathya: Fresh unsalted butter 10–15 g with sugar; Shashtika rice with dal, ghee, buttermilk at lunch (not at night); Fulfil safe, wholesome cravings (Dauhrida) — fruits, sweets in moderation. Ksheera/Ghrita: Ksheera-Navanita — Fresh butter (Navanita) from milk, 10–15 g with warm milk or sugar; Sushruta: Shashtika with curd, milk and Jangala-mamsa rasa (or dal soup for vegetarians). Rationale: As the fetal heart manifests, the mother's wishes are the fetus's wishes (Dauhridavastha). Respecting safe desires preserves Manas-prasada and avoids malformations attributed to Dauhrida-vimanana.
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 14–17 · Second trimester begins: Fetal sex organs differentiate, lanugo appears, fundus midway between symphysis and umbilicus at 16 weeks. Start iron 100 mg elemental + folic acid 500 mcg, calcium 500 mg BD. Td dose 1/2, quad marker 15–20 weeks. Mother usually feels well — appetite improves.
red_flags: Watery leak PV (PPROM)
Painless bleeding
Severe headache with high BP (early pre-eclampsia is rare but possible)
tags: apathya: Denying wholesome cravings (risk of Vata aggravation and mental distress per Charaka); Unsafe cravings — raw clay, ice, unwashed raw food

plan.fetal: Garbha attains Sthirata (stability); mother becomes heavier (Guru-gatra). Hridaya manifests — the Dauhrida state: the mother expresses the fetus's desires through her own cravings.

red_flags: Preterm contractions < 37 weeks
Antepartum bleeding
Persistent headache / visual disturbance / epigastric pain
tags: apathya: Heavy, oily or fermented foods; Long standing/travel; sleeping on back

plan.fetal: All body parts and organs are fully developed (Sarvairbhavair Apyayate). Mother becomes fatigued (Klanta) due to maximal fetal demands.

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — 8th Month Ojas Instability & Ksheera-Yavagu Regimen
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: अष्टमे मासि गर्भश्च माता च परस्परत ओजोऽऽददाते, तस्मात्तदा गर्भिणी मुहुर्मुहुर्मुदिता मुहुर्मुहुश्च म्लाना भवति। ओजसोऽनवस्थितत्वात्॥
chunks.transliteration: aṣṭame māsi garbhaśca mātā ca parasparata ojo''dadāte, tasmāttadā garbhiṇī muhurmuhurmuditā muhurmuhuśca mlānā bhavati | ojaso'navasthitatvāt ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: आठवें महीने में ओज माता और गर्भ के बीच रसवाही नाड़ियों द्वारा बार-बार आदान-प्रदान करता है (अस्थिर रहता है)। इस कारण गर्भिणी कभी अत्यधिक प्रसन्न (उत्साही) और कभी अचानक ग्लानि (थकी हुई/उदास) प्रतीत होती है। इस मास में प्रसव होने पर ओज के अभाव के कारण माता और शिशु दोनों का जीवन संशयास्पद होता है। अतः क्षीर-यवागु घृतयुक्त आहार और शान्तिपूर्ण ओजोरक्षक परिचर्या दें।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: In the eighth month, vital Ojas remains physiologically unstable, continually circulating between mother and fetus via the placental-umbilical vessels. Consequently, the mother experiences alternating bouts of elation and profound fatigue. Delivery during this month is fraught with peril for both mother and neonate due to transient lack of Ojas (depressed immune resilience). Clinical regimen demands Ksheera-Yavagu with cow's ghee, emotional tranquility, avoidance of travel, and complete preservation of maternal energy.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 4 (32-36 weeks) & Ch. 21 (Preterm Labor): Corresponds to late preterm vulnerability (32-36 weeks gestation). Fetal pulmonary surfactant production is still incomplete, temperature regulation is fragile, and neonatal morbidity from sepsis and respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) is significantly high if born prematurely before 36 weeks.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Ojas is the Sara of all Dhatus. Due to rapid third-trimester fetal weight accrual and somatic transfer, Ojas oscillates. Madhura-Snigdha Ksheera and Ghrita provide instant Ojas replenishment.
red_flags: Preterm labor contractions (>4 painful uterine contractions per hour)
Watery fluid leakage PV (PPROM - Preterm premature rupture of membranes)
Elevated blood pressure (>140/90 mmHg) with proteinuria (preeclampsia risk)

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — 9th Month Anuvasana Basti & Yoni Pichu Protocol
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: नवमे मासि गर्भिण्या मधुरौषधसिद्धेन सर्पिषा पयसा चानूवासयेत्। अपि चैवास्या योनौ पिचुं दद्यात् सार्षपतैलेन वा मधुकसिद्धेन वा वातानुलोमनाय सुखप्रसवाय च॥
chunks.transliteration: navame māsi garbhiṇyā madhurauṣadhasiddhena sarpiṣā payasā cānūvāsayet | api caivāsyā yonau picuṁ dadyāt sārṣapatailena vā madhukasiddhena vā vātānulomanāya sukhaprasavāya ca ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: नौवें महीने में गर्भिणी को मधुर गण की औषधियों से सिद्ध तैल/घृत द्वारा अनुवासन बस्ति देनी चाहिए, तथा मधुर औषध सिद्ध तैल (जैसे बला तैल / मधुकादि तैल) का योनि पिचु (medicated vaginal tampon) धारण कराना चाहिए। इससे अपान वायु का अनुलोमन होता है, गर्भाशय ग्रीवा एवं योनि मार्ग कोमल और स्निग्ध हो जाते हैं, और बिना कष्ट के सुखप्रसव होता है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: In the ninth month, Charaka mandates Anuvasana Basti (unctuous retention enema) prepared with Madhura Gana medicated oils (such as Bala Taila or Sukumara Ghrita) alongside sterile Yoni Pichu (medicated vaginal tampon) soaked in Bala Taila or Yashtimadhu Taila. This pacifies Apana Vata, softens the cervix and pelvic ligaments, lubricates the birth canal, ensures downward direction of labor forces, and facilitates uncomplicated normal vaginal delivery (Sukhaprasava).
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 11 & 12 (Physiology and Mechanism of Normal Labor): Direct correlation with cervical ripening, softening, and favorable Bishop score (cervical effacement and dilation). Pelvic floor relaxation and perineal lubrication reduce second-stage perineal lacerations and dysfunctional labor.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Apana Vata governs the expulsion of Garbha, Mutra, Purisha, and Artava. Medicated oil Basti directly enters the rectal ampulla, pacifying Apana Vata at its primary seat (Pakvashaya) and softening the vaginal canal via Snigdha Guna.
red_flags: Active painless bleeding PV (Placenta Previa - Basti and Pichu are strictly contraindicated)
Foul-smelling vaginal discharge (Chorioamnionitis)
Spontaneous rupture of membranes with clear or meconium liquor

chunks.english: 9th month: unctuous food, Anuvasana Basti and Yoni Pichu for easy delivery. chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 35–40+ · Term, engagement & labour: Term = 37–41+6 weeks. chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — Shukra-Shonita Sampat & Garbhadhana Factors
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: ध्रुवं चतुर्णां सान्निध्याद्गर्भः स्याद्विधिवत्कृतः। ऋतुक्षेत्राम्बुबीजानां सामग्र्यादङ्कुरो यथा॥
chunks.transliteration: dhruvaṁ caturṇāṁ sānnidhyādgarbhaḥ syādvidhivatkṛtaḥ | ṛtukṣetrāmbubījānāṁ sāmagryādaṅkuro yathā ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: जैसे ऋतु (उचित काल/मौसम), क्षेत्र (उर्वर भूमि), अम्बु (जल/पोषण) और बीज (उत्तम बीज) की समग्रता से अंकुर उत्पन्न होता है, वैसे ही ऋतु (ऋतुकाल/ovulatory window), क्षेत्र (गर्भाशय/endometrium), अम्बु (रस/रक्त पोषण) और बीज (विशुद्ध शुक्र एवं आर्तव) की समग्रता से स्वस्थ गर्भ स्थापित होता है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Charaka establishes the four prerequisite cardinal factors for successful conception and embryogenesis: Ritu (ovulatory fertile window), Kshetra (healthy uterine cavity and receptive endometrium), Ambu (nutrient maternal plasma/Rasa Dhatu), and Bija (unvitiated ovum and spermatozoon). Any qualitative or quantitative deficiency in these four factors results in subfertility or spontaneous early pregnancy loss.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 3 & 4 (Fertilization and Implantation): Corresponds directly to the pre-conceptional prerequisites: viable gametes (Bija - sperm and oocyte), correct timing during the fertile window (Ritu - days 12-16 of cycle), receptive secretory endometrium with pinopodes (Kshetra), and optimal utero-placental perfusion and hormonal milieu with progesterone and hCG (Ambu).
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Garbhadhana occurs when Vata directs Shukra and Artava together without Dosha Dushti. Ambu (Rasa Dhatu) provides initial unctuous nutrition (Sneha) to prevent Kalala desiccation.
red_flags: Secondary amenorrhea with negative pregnancy test
Severe lower abdominal pain with suspected ectopic gestation
Habitual abortion (>2 consecutive first-trimester losses)

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — Shadgarbhadharana (Six Procreative Progenitors)
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: मातृजश्चायं गर्भः, पितृजश्च, आत्मजश्च, सात्म्यजश्च, रसजश्च, सत्त्वजश्चेति॥
chunks.transliteration: mātṛjaścāyaṁ garbhaḥ, pitṛjaśca, ātmajaśca, sātmyajaśca, rasajaśca, sattvajaśceti ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: यह गर्भ मातृज (माता से मृदु अंग जैसे त्वचा, मांस, रक्त, मेद, हृदय, यकृत, प्लीहा), पितृज (पिता से स्थिर अंग जैसे अस्थि, दन्त, केश, स्नायु, धमनी), आत्मज (चेतना, इन्द्रिय ज्ञान, आयु), सात्म्यज (आरोग्य, ओज, वीर्य), रसज (शरीर वृद्धि, प्राण, पुष्टि) और सत्त्वज (मनोभाव, स्मृति, भक्ति, शील) इन छह भावों के संयोग से उत्पन्न होता है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Charaka explains that the fetus is composite of six fundamental maternal, paternal, and environmental factors: Matrija (soft maternal tissues including liver, spleen, heart), Pitrija (hard paternal structures including bone, teeth, tendons), Atmaja (consciousness, lifespan, sense organs), Satmyaja (maternal adaptogenic resilience and immunity), Rasaja (fetal somatic growth directly dependent on maternal nutrition), and Sattvaja (psychological traits and mental equilibrium).
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 3 & 9: Corresponds to polygenic and environmental inheritance: maternal and paternal genomic contribution (autosomal chromosomes and maternal mitochondrial DNA), intrauterine nutritional environment (fetal programming / Barker hypothesis), and maternal neuro-endocrine impact on fetal neurodevelopment.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Rasaja Bhavas represent maternal Rasa Dhatu passing through the placenta via Upasneha and Upasveda. Defective maternal nutrition directly impairs Rasaja Bhavas leading to Upavishtaka (IUGR).
red_flags: Severe maternal malnutrition or hyperemesis leading to ketonuria
Intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) on ultrasound
Oligohydramnios (AFI < 5 cm)

chunks.sanskrit_shloka: ऋतौ तु प्रथमे दिवसे गर्भाशयो विशुद्ध्यति। ततः प्रभृति त्रिरात्रं गर्भिणीवदासीत, ब्रह्मचारिणी, अक्रोधना, हविष्यं भुञ्जाना॥
chunks.transliteration: ṛtau tu prathame divase garbhāśayo viśuddhyati | tataḥ prabhṛti trirātraṁ garbhiṇīvadāsīta, brahmacāriṇī, akrodhanā, haviṣyaṁ bhuñjānā ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: ऋतुकाल (माहवारी) के प्रथम दिवस से गर्भाशय का शोधन होता है। प्रथम तीन दिन स्त्री को ब्रह्मचारिणी रहकर, क्रोध त्यागकर, हल्का हविष्य अन्न (दलिया/दूध-चावल) ग्रहण करना चाहिए तथा दिन में सोने और परिश्रम से बचना चाहिए, ताकि गर्भाशय की ग्रहण शक्ति उत्तम रहे।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Sushruta delineates the clinical regimen for the fertile menstrual phase (Ritumati Paricharya). During the initial three days of menstruation, the endometrial lining sheds and purifies itself. The woman should consume light, nourishing Haviṣya food, avoid physical exertion and emotional stress, maintain pelvic hygiene, and preserve somatic tranquility to prepare the endometrium for blastocyst implantation.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 3 & 7: Corresponds to the menstrual phase (days 1-4) and early follicular phase of the uterine cycle. Gentle rest, iron-rich diet, and prevention of pelvic inflammatory infections safeguard tubal patency and ovarian follicular maturation.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Artava discharge is governed by Apana Vata. Mental serenity and light diet prevent Vata-Pitta Dushti in the Artavavaha Srotas.
red_flags: Menorrhagia soaking >1 pad every 2 hours with large clots
Severe acute pelvic pain suggesting pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) or ruptured endometrioma

chunks.title: Sushruta Samhita — Fetal Hemodynamics & Nabhi Nadi (Umbilical Circulation)
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: मातुस्तु खलु रसवहाया नाड्या गर्भनाभिनाडी संबद्धा, सा तस्य मातुरुपस्नेहेनाप्याययति। यथा कुल्योदकेन केदारमाप्यायते तथा॥
chunks.transliteration: mātustu khalu rasavahāyā nāḍyā garbhanābhināḍī saṁbaddhā, sā tasya mātūrapasnehenāpyāyayati | yathā kulyodakena kedāramāpyāyate tathā ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: माता की रसवाही नाड़ियों से गर्भ की नाभि-नाड़ी (umbilical cord) जुड़ी होती है। जैसे नहर के जल से धान का खेत सींचा जाता है, ठीक उसी प्रकार माता के रसधातु के उपस्नेह (diffusion) और उपस्वेद द्वारा गर्भ का निरंतर पोषण और संवर्धन होता है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Sushruta details the hemodynamic connection between mother and fetus: the maternal uterine arteries and intervillous spaces connect functional nutrient streams to the fetal umbilical cord (Garbha Nabhi Nadi). Through the biological mechanisms of Upasneha (trans-placental micro-diffusion) and Upasveda (osmotic perfusion), maternal nutrients directly nourish every fetal Dhatu without direct maternal-fetal vessel continuity, exactly like irrigation water nourishing field crops.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 4 (Placental Circulation): Uteroplacental circulation consists of ~120 spiral arteries discharging maternal blood directly into the intervillous space at low pressure. Gas, nutrient, and waste exchange occurs across the syncytiotrophoblast placental barrier into the umbilical vein.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Rasa Dhatu enriched with Prana and Ojas traverses through the Nabhi Nadi. Maternal anemia (Pandu) impairs the oxygen carrying capacity of Rasa-Rakta, starving the fetal tissues.
red_flags: Abnormal umbilical artery Doppler (absent or reversed end-diastolic flow - AREDF)
Severe maternal pallor with Hb < 7 g/dL (Severe Gestational Anemia)
Fetal growth deceleration lagging >2 weeks behind gestational age

chunks.sanskrit: प्रथमे मासि संमूर्छितः सर्वधातुकलुषीकृतः खेटभूतो गर्भो भवत्यव्यक्तविग्रहः
chunks.iast: prathame māsi saṃmūrchitaḥ sarvadhātukaluṣīkṛtaḥ kheṭabhūto garbho bhavaty avyaktavigrahaḥ
chunks.hindi: पहले माह में गर्भ सम्मूर्छित, सभी धातुओं से मिश्रित, कलल अवस्था में अव्यक्त स्वरूप का होता है।
chunks.english: Month 1: the embryo is a fused, unmanifest mass (Kalala, Kheta-bhuta) with all Dhatu mixed — no distinct form. Samurchchhita (fertilised) Kalala — an unmanifest, jelly-like embryo (Khetabhuta, Avyakta-vigraha). Atma, Manas and the Panchamahabhuta join the Shukra-Shonita.
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 1–4 · Fertilisation, implantation & booking: Fertilisation in the ampulla, implantation on day 6–7, hCG detectable ~8–10 days post-ovulation; UPT positive at missed period. Confirm pregnancy, calculate EDD (Naegele: LMP + 9 months + 7 days), start folic acid 400 mcg (5 mg in high-risk), book ANC early, avoid teratogens (alcohol, tobacco, unsupervised drugs, radiation).
red_flags: Bleeding PV with lower-abdominal pain (threatened abortion / ectopic)
Severe one-sided pelvic pain or shoulder-tip pain
Persistent vomiting with inability to retain fluids

chunks.title: Sushruta Samhita — Kalala, Budbuda & Five Primordia (Panchapindaka)
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: तत्र प्रथमे मासि कललं जायते; द्वितीये शीतोष्णेन पवनेनाभिपच्यमानानां महाभूतानां संघातः पिण्डः पेश्यर्बुदं वा भवति; तृतीये हस्तपादशिरसां पञ्च पिण्डका निर्वर्तन्ते॥
chunks.transliteration: tatra prathame māsi kalalaṁ jāyate; dvitīye śītoṣṇena pavanenābhipacyamānānāṁ mahābhūtānāṁ saṁghātaḥ piṇḍaḥ peśyarbudaṁ vā bhavati; tṛtīye hastapādaśirasāṁ pañca piṇḍakā nirvartante ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: प्रथम मास में गर्भ कलल (jelly-like blastocyst) रूप में रहता है। द्वितीय मास में शीतोष्ण वायु द्वारा महाभूतों का संहनन होकर पिण्ड (पुरुष), पेशी (स्त्री) या अर्बुद रूप धारण करता है। तृतीय मास में दोनों हाथ, दोनों पैर और सिर—ये पांच पिण्डक (Panchapindaka) स्पष्ट रूप से विकसित होते हैं।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Sushruta describes early surgical-grade embryogenesis: In month 1, the conceptus exists as delicate Kalala (amorphous morula/blastocyst). In month 2, under the bio-catalytic action of Agni and Vayu, the cellular mass condenses into Pinda, Peshi, or Arbuda. In month 3, organ differentiation produces the 'Panchapindaka'—the five structural bud primordia representing the cephalic pole and the four limb buds.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 4 (Embryology Weeks 4-12): Matches Carnegie stages 10-18: Limb buds appear at week 4-5; by week 8 (end of embryonic period), crown-rump length is ~30 mm, fingers and toes are separated, facial features are recognizable, and early ossification begins.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Panchamahabhuta division is executed by Vayu (Vibhajanat). Sheeta-Madhura herbs in months 1-3 shield the embryonic cell mass from Pittaja Pitta-vidaha (teratogenic thermal stress).
red_flags: Early vaginal spotting with falling serum beta-hCG titers
Absent fetal pole on transvaginal ultrasound at 7 weeks (Anembryonic pregnancy / Blighted ovum)

chunks.iast: dvitīye māsi ghanaḥ sampadyate piṇḍaḥ peśī arbudaṃ vā
chunks.hindi: दूसरे माह में गर्भ घन होकर पिण्ड (पुरुष), पेशी (स्त्री) अथवा अर्बुद (नपुंसक) का रूप लेता है।

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — 4th Month Dauhrida (द्विहृदया / Fetal Heart & Maternal Desires)
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: चतुर्थे मासि स्थिरत्वमापद्यते गर्भः, तस्मात्तदा गर्भिणी गुरुगात्रत्वमधिकमापद्यते। द्विहृदयां च तदा गर्भिणीमाचक्षते॥
chunks.transliteration: caturthe māsi sthiratvamāpadyate garbhaḥ, tasmāttadā garbhiṇī gurugātratvamadhikamāpadyate | dvihṛdayāṁ ca tadā garbhiṇīmācakṣate ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: चौथे महीने में गर्भ में स्थिरता आ जाती है, जिससे गर्भिणी के शरीर में भारीपन बढ़ जाता है। इस मास में गर्भस्थ हृदय के प्रस्फुटित होने से गर्भिणी को 'द्विहृदया' (दो हृदय वाली) कहा जाता है। गर्भ अपनी इच्छाओं को माता के हृदय के माध्यम से प्रकट करता है, अतः दौहृद की पूर्ति अनिवार्य है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: In the fourth month, fetal somatic structures achieve physical stability (Sthiratva), imparting a sensation of bodily heaviness (Gurugatratva) to the mother. The fetal heart functionally coordinates with the maternal cardiovascular system; hence the pregnant woman is called 'Dvihridaya' (bearing two hearts). Fetal desires and sensory cravings manifest through maternal longings (Dauhrida). Non-fulfilment or suppression of Dauhrida causes fetal deformities, mental instability, or pregnancy complications.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 4 (Fetal Development at 16 weeks) & Ch. 8 (Maternal Systemic Adaptations): Fetal heart sounds are readily audible with Doppler; cardiovascular output reaches 40-50% above pre-pregnancy levels. Second-trimester pregnancy cravings, altered olfactory and gustatory perception are neuro-endocrinologically mediated by beta-hCG, progesterone, and leptin fluctuations.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Vata directs the circulation of Rasavaha Nadis between fetal and maternal heart. Suppressing Dauhrida irritates Vata, which may derange fetal limb morphogenesis or neuromuscular tone.
red_flags: Severe persistent pica (eating mud, chalk, clay - indicative of severe iron deficiency anemia)
Maternal fainting spells or orthostatic hypotension
Absent fetal heart tones on Doppler after 14-16 weeks

chunks.sanskrit: चतुर्थे मासे स्थिरत्वमापद्यते गर्भः; हृदयस्य व्यक्तीभावः — द्विहृदया नारी दौहृदिनी
chunks.iast: caturthe māse sthiratvam āpadyate garbhaḥ; hṛdayasya vyaktībhāvaḥ — dvihṛdayā nārī dauhṛdinī
chunks.hindi: चौथे माह में गर्भ स्थिर होता है तथा हृदय व्यक्त होता है; स्त्री द्विहृदया (दौहृदिनी) कहलाती है।
chunks.english: Month 4: stability of the fetus; the heart manifests so the woman is Dvihridaya — she has Dauhrida (pregnancy cravings representing the fetus’s wishes). Garbha attains Sthirata (stability); mother becomes heavier (Guru-gatra). Hridaya manifests — the Dauhrida state: the mother expresses the fetus's desires through her own cravings.
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 14–17 · Second trimester begins: Fetal sex organs differentiate, lanugo appears, fundus midway between symphysis and umbilicus at 16 weeks. Start iron 100 mg elemental + folic acid 500 mcg, calcium 500 mg BD. Td dose 1/2, quad marker 15–20 weeks. Mother usually feels well — appetite improves.
red_flags: Watery leak PV (PPROM)
Painless bleeding
Severe headache with high BP (early pre-eclampsia is rare but possible)

chunks.english: Month 5: maximal growth of Mamsa and Shonita; mind (Manas) becomes more awake; mother becomes lean. Fetal muscle (Mamsa) and blood (Shonita) increase most; the mother becomes lean (Karshya). Manas is more awakened — fetal movements begin to be felt.
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 18–21 · Quickening & anomaly scan: Quickening at 16–18 weeks in multigravida, ~20 in primigravida. Fundus at umbilicus at 20–22 weeks; FHS audible by fetoscope. Level-II anomaly scan 18–20 weeks; Td 2nd dose; Hb check; weight gain ~0.4 kg/week from now.
red_flags: No fetal movement by 22 weeks
Persistent abdominal pain / uterine tenderness
Pallor with Hb < 10 g/dl

chunks.english: Month 6: maximal increase in Bala and Varna; intellect (Buddhi) awakens; the mother loses strength and colour. Fetal strength (Bala) and complexion (Varna) increase most; mother may lose strength and colour. Buddhi (intellect) becomes more awakened.
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 22–26 · Viability & GDM screening: Viability from ~24 weeks (surfactant starts). OGTT 75 g at 24–28 weeks (≥140 mg/dl at 2 h = GDM). Monitor BP and urine albumin at each visit — pre-eclampsia screening; edema of feet is physiological, face/hand edema is not. Repeat Hb at 28 weeks.
red_flags: BP ≥ 140/90 mmHg
Facial / hand swelling with headache
Reduced fetal movement
Hb < 9 g/dl or polyuria-polydipsia (GDM)

chunks.sanskrit: सप्तमे मासे गर्भः सर्वैर्भावैराप्यायते
chunks.iast: saptame māse garbhaḥ sarvair bhāvair āpyāyate
chunks.hindi: सातवें माह में गर्भ सभी भावों से पूर्ण रूप से परिपुष्ट होता है।
chunks.english: Month 7: the fetus is fully endowed with all Bhavas; mother is most fatigued. All body parts and organs are fully developed (Sarvairbhavair Apyayate). Mother becomes fatigued (Klanta) due to maximal fetal demands.
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 27–30 · Third trimester: Third trimester begins at 28 weeks; FH ≈ gestational weeks in cm (±2). Anti-D 300 mcg at 28 weeks if Rh-negative & indirect Coombs negative; Tdap 27–36 weeks; kick-count (≥10 movements in 12 h); visits every 2 weeks. Screen for anemia, GDM, pre-eclampsia, IUGR.
red_flags: Preterm contractions < 37 weeks
Antepartum bleeding
Persistent headache / visual disturbance / epigastric pain

chunks.iast: aṣṭame māse garbhamātṛ-ojasoḥ sañcāritvāt jāto na jīvati
chunks.hindi: आठवें माह में गर्भ और माता के ओज के आदान-प्रदान से अस्थिरता रहती है; इस काल में जन्मा शिशु प्रायः नहीं जीता।
chunks.english: Month 8: Ojas oscillates between mother and fetus (unstable) so a baby born now is vulnerable — special Ojas care. Ojas oscillates between mother and fetus (Ojas-sancharitvam): when more in the mother the fetus is weak; when more in the fetus the mother is lethargic. Delivery in this month carries risk — hence special Ojas rakshana.
chunks.citation: Ch. Sha. 4.22; Su. Sha. 3; A.H. Sha. 1
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 31–34 · Late preterm window: Rapid weight gain and brain growth; lungs maturing. Growth scan with liquor and Doppler if indicated; NST for high-risk; steroids (betamethasone) if preterm delivery anticipated. Fetal presentation assessed from 32–34 weeks; visits every 2 weeks (weekly from 36).
red_flags: Regular painful contractions
Rupture of membranes
Bleeding PV
Severe pre-eclampsia features
Absent / reduced fetal movement

chunks.iast: navame daśame ekādaśe dvādaśe vā māse prasavakālaḥ
chunks.hindi: नवें से बारहवें माह के बीच प्रसव-काल होता है।
chunks.english: Month 9: the fetus is complete; Prasava-Kala (time of delivery) falls between the 9th and 12th month. Garbha is fully developed; Prasava Kala occurs in the 9th–12th month. Head engages, Apana Vayu directs the fetus downward for Sukhaprasava.
chunks.dc_dutta: Weeks 35–40+ · Term, engagement & labour: Term = 37–41+6 weeks. Lightening (engagement) in primigravida 2–3 weeks before labour; true labour: regular, progressive contractions, show, cervical dilatation. Weekly visits from 36 weeks, NST/AFI as indicated; Bishop score; induction considered after 41 weeks. Sukhaprasava = spontaneous vaginal delivery with active management of third stage.
red_flags: Leaking liquor / rupture of membranes
Regular contractions every 5 min
Reduced or absent fetal movement
Bleeding PV
Severe headache, blurred vision, convulsions

chunks.english: In Grishma the sun drains moisture and Soma from the body, so cold, liquid, unctuous and sweet food is wholesome. Dosha state: Vata accumulates; Pitta rises; Agni and Bala are weakest, dehydration risk. Focus: Cooling hydration: Madhura, Sheeta, Snigdha, Drava food. Avoid sour, salty, pungent & hot exposure. Pathya: Rice, wheat in moderation, cooling soups, moong; ghee & milk; Fruit: sweet mango (small), watermelon, muskmelon, grapes, pomegranate; Coconut water, buttermilk (day), Panaka — jaggery-water, sattu drink, barley-water; Mint-fennel cooling drink (Saunf sharbat), rose-water milk; 3–3.5 litres fluids daily. Avoid: Hot, spicy, fried, sour, salty food; Direct sun exposure; heat-stroke prone travel; Excess exercise & prolonged fasting; Alcohol and caffeine. Lifestyle: Cool shower (lukewarm on abdomen), light cotton clothes; Sandalwood-coconut-oil Abhyanga (Chandanadi / Sheeta taila); Midday rest (Divaswapna allowed 45–60 min — only Ritu where permitted); Moon-lit terrace walk in the evening. Day-sleep: Divaswapna: ALLOWED — 45–60 min in a cool room, reclined on left side. Water: Cool (earthen-pot) water; never ice-cold.
chunks.dc_dutta: Heat, dehydration, UTI and leg-cramps rise; ensure ≥3 L fluids and ORS if sweating; urine should be pale. Heat-stroke and pre-eclampsia are risks. Avoid exertion in the heat; watch for Braxton-Hicks provoked by dehydration.

chunks.english_clinical_summary: In Grishma the sun drains moisture and Soma from the body, so cold, liquid, unctuous and sweet food is wholesome. Dosha state: Vata accumulates; Pitta rises; Agni and Bala are weakest, dehydration risk. Focus: Cooling hydration: Madhura, Sheeta, Snigdha, Drava food. Avoid sour, salty, pungent & hot exposure. Pathya: Rice, wheat in moderation, cooling soups, moong; ghee & milk; Fruit: sweet mango (small), watermelon, muskmelon, grapes, pomegranate; Coconut water, buttermilk (day), Panaka — jaggery-water, sattu drink, barley-water; Mint-fennel cooling drink (Saunf sharbat), rose-water milk; 3–3.5 litres fluids daily. Avoid: Hot, spicy, fried, sour, salty food; Direct sun exposure; heat-stroke prone travel; Excess exercise & prolonged fasting; Alcohol and caffeine. Lifestyle: Cool shower (lukewarm on abdomen), light cotton clothes; Sandalwood-coconut-oil Abhyanga (Chandanadi / Sheeta taila); Midday rest (Divaswapna allowed 45–60 min — only Ritu where permitted); Moon-lit terrace walk in the evening. Day-sleep: Divaswapna: ALLOWED — 45–60 min in a cool room, reclined on left side. Water: Cool (earthen-pot) water; never ice-cold.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: Heat, dehydration, UTI and leg-cramps rise; ensure ≥3 L fluids and ORS if sweating; urine should be pale. Heat-stroke and pre-eclampsia are risks. Avoid exertion in the heat; watch for Braxton-Hicks provoked by dehydration.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Vata-Pitta equilibrium is maintained via Snigdha, Madhura, and Sheeta Gunas. Supports Rasa Dhatu circulation to Garbha and prevents Dhatu Kshaya.

chunks.sanskrit: शीते शीतानिलस्पर्शसंरुद्धो बलिनां बली । पक्ता भवति हेमन्ते भृशमाहारकाङ्क्षी
chunks.iast: śīte śītānilasparśasaṃruddho balināṃ balī | paktā bhavati hemante bhṛśam āhārakāṅkṣī
chunks.hindi: शीत ऋतु में जठराग्नि बलवान होती है, अतः आहार की इच्छा अधिक होती है; स्निग्ध-गुरु आहार पच जाता है।
chunks.english: In Hemanta the cold air confines Agni inside, making it strong; the person craves food and can digest heavier, unctuous meals. Dosha state: Kapha accumulates; Agni strong (Pakta Balinam Bali). Focus: Agni is strongest — do not under-eat. Snigdha, Madhura, Amla-Lavana, warm foods; sun-exposure and warm oil massage. Pathya: Warm, unctuous, sweet meals — ghee, wheat, rice, urad-dal in moderation; Warm milk with ghee, dry-fruit laddu, til-jaggery in small amounts; Vegetable soups with ginger and garlic (if suited), moong-dal khichdi; Seasonal fruit: orange, amla, guava; Drink warm water. Avoid: Cold water, ice, cold drinks; Fasting & Ruksha-Laghu food; Cold wind & damp floors; sleeping uncovered; Excess Vata-aggravating dry snacks. Lifestyle: Warm oil Abhyanga with Til/Bala taila daily; Gentle sun-bath 15 min after sunrise; Warm clothes and covered feet/head. Day-sleep: Divaswapna: AVOID (Kapha). Water: Warm / lukewarm water.
chunks.dc_dutta: Cold exposure & dehydration are less problematic; maintain adequate calories (+300 kcal/day in 2nd–3rd trimester), keep warm, check seasonal influenza vaccination (inactivated) per MoHFW/ACOG guidance and monitor for respiratory infections.

chunks.sanskrit: तप्तं तप्तांशुकिरणैः शीतं शीतांशुरश्मिभिः । समन्तादप्यहोरात्रमगस्त्योदयनिर्विषम्
chunks.iast: taptaṃ taptāṃśukiraṇaiḥ śītaṃ śītāṃśuraśmibhiḥ | samantād apy ahorātram agastyodayanirviṣam
chunks.hindi: शरद में दिन में सूर्य-ताप और रात्रि में चन्द्र-किरणों से तपा-ठंडा हुआ जल (हंसोदक) अगस्त्य उदय के बाद निर्विष और हितकर होता है।
chunks.english: In Sharad, water warmed by the sun by day and cooled by moon-rays by night (Hamsodaka) becomes pure and wholesome after the rise of Agastya. Dosha state: Pitta prakopa (accumulated in Varsha); Agni moderate; acidity, skin rash, fever tendencies. Focus: Pacify Pitta: Madhura, Tikta, Kashaya rasa; cool, light foods; Ghrita (Tikta-ghrita if prescribed). Avoid hot sun and spicy, sour, salty food. Pathya: Rice, wheat, barley, moong; sweet-bitter vegetables (lauki, parwal, ridge-gourd); Ghee, milk, Shatavari kalpa, Amla murabba (small); Pomegranate, grapes, sweet fruits, coconut water; Cool (not cold) water kept in sun & moonlight (Hamsodaka); Bitter-leaf soup in small amounts. Avoid: Hot-spicy, fried, sour, fermented food; curd; Excess salt, alcohol & oil; Midday sun, day-sleep, anger; Heavy exertion in heat. Lifestyle: Evening moon-lit walks; cool sandal-paste on forehead; Light cotton clothes; avoid heat & sun; Soothing music, pleasant surroundings (Garbha Sanskar). Day-sleep: Divaswapna: AVOID; rest 20 min only. Water: Hamsodaka — sun-warmed, moon-cooled boiled water.
chunks.dc_dutta: Hyperacidity/heartburn and skin rashes (PUPPP, obstetric cholestasis — itching of palms/soles needs LFT & bile acids) can increase; dengue/malaria tail-end persists. Small frequent meals, elevate head-end, antacids on prescription.

chunks.sanskrit: हेमन्तवत् शिशिरे विधिः कार्यः विशेषतः कटुतिक्तकषायवर्जनम्
chunks.iast: hemantavat śiśire vidhiḥ kāryaḥ viśeṣataḥ kaṭutiktakaṣāyavarjanam
chunks.hindi: शिशिर में हेमन्त के समान विधि अपनाएँ; विशेषकर कटु-तिक्त-कषाय रस का अधिक सेवन न करें।
chunks.english: Follow the Hemanta regimen in Shishira, especially limiting excessive Katu, Tikta and Kashaya rasa. Dosha state: Kapha accumulation continues; Vata dry & cold; Agni still strong. Focus: Similar to Hemanta, but cold is harsher and drier — emphasise Snigdha, Ushna food and warmth; protect from dry, cold winds. Pathya: Ghee-laden hot khichdi, wheat roti with ghee; Warm milk with turmeric and Shatavari (if advised); Moderate Katu-Tikta spices: ginger, cumin, ajwain in small dose; Soups of moong, drumstick, pumpkin; cooked winter greens (palak, methi in moderation); Sesame-jaggery in small amounts after the first trimester only. Avoid: Cold drinks and cold exposure; Excess Ruksha (dry) foods — puffed rice snacks, biscuits; Day-sleep and heavy exertion; Raw salads in the evening. Lifestyle: Warm oil massage, warm baths (not hot); Light walks at noon in sunlight; Cover ears, chest, feet. Day-sleep: Divaswapna: AVOID; rest 20 min reclined only. Water: Warm water, ginger-tulsi water.
chunks.dc_dutta: Winter respiratory illnesses and dry skin are common; maintain hydration, vitamin D (sun exposure + supplement 400–600 IU), seasonal flu shot, watch for pre-eclampsia (winter BP rise) at every visit.

Severe headache with visual disturbance (photophobia)
Sudden swelling of face and hands
Marked reduction or absence of fetal movements

chunks.sanskrit: आदानग्लानदेहानामग्निः सन्नोऽपि सर्वदा । वर्षास्वनिलादिदोषैर्दुष्यन्ति कुपिता जलैः
chunks.iast: ādānaglānadehānām agniḥ sanno'pi sarvadā | varṣāsv anilādidoṣair dūṣyanti kupitā jalaiḥ
chunks.hindi: वर्षा में पहले से दुर्बल शरीर की अग्नि मंद हो जाती है और दूषित जल व दोषों से रोग होते हैं; अतः अग्निदीपन व शुद्ध जल आवश्यक है।
chunks.english: In Varsha the Agni of a body already weakened in summer is dull, and vitiated waters and doshas cause illness — kindle Agni and drink purified water. Dosha state: Vata aggravates; Pitta accumulates; Agni is Manda; water & food-borne infections. Focus: Agnideepana and boiled water. Light, warm, freshly cooked, mildly sour-salty-unctuous food; strict hygiene. Pathya: Old rice, wheat, barley, moong; honey in small amounts with warm water; Freshly cooked warm soups: ginger-cumin-pepper (small), vegetable broth; Boiled-and-cooled water with Shunthi / Dhanyaka (Agnideepana); Cooked vegetables, lauki, pumpkin; avoid raw leafy greens; Buttermilk with roasted cumin & rock-salt at lunch. Avoid: Raw salads, street food, cut fruit, stale or leftover food; Curd at night, river fish, heavy, oily or fermented foods; Day-sleep, wet clothes, wading in water; Unfiltered water; ice. Lifestyle: Always drink boiled water; Dry the body after rain; Dhupana (smoke-fumigation) of room with neem/guggul if allowed; Mosquito-nets and repellent (dengue, malaria); Light Abhyanga with warm Tila taila. Day-sleep: Divaswapna: AVOID. Water: Boiled & cooled water with Shunthi / Dhanyaka.
chunks.dc_dutta: Peak season for diarrhoeal diseases, hepatitis E, typhoid, malaria and dengue — all hazardous in pregnancy (Hepatitis E: high mortality in pregnancy; malaria: prompt treatment, ITN use). Boil/filter water, hygiene, mosquito-protection; any fever needs same-day medical review.

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — Six Ritus & Seasonal Maternal Adaptation
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: इह खलु संवत्सरो षडृतुको भवति। आदानकालः शीतोष्णरूक्षैर्बलमादत्ते, विसर्गकालस्तु सौम्यस्निग्धैर्बलं विसृजति॥
chunks.transliteration: iha khalu saṁvatsaro ṣaḍṛtuko bhavati | ādānakālaḥ śītoṣṇarūkṣairbalamādatte, visargakālastu saumyasnigdhairbalaṁ visṛjati ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: वर्ष छह ऋतुओं में विभाजित है: आदान काल (शिशिर, वसन्त, ग्रीष्म) जिसमें सूर्य और वायु शरीर के बल का हरण करते हैं, तथा विसर्ग काल (वर्षा, शरद्, हेमन्त) जिसमें चन्द्रमा का सौम्य प्रभाव शरीर के बल और धातुओं की पुष्टि करता है। गर्भिणी को ऋतु के अनुसार आहार-विहार में परिमार्जन करना चाहिए।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Charaka classifies the annual seasonal cycle into Adana Kala (northern solstice: Shishira, Vasanta, Grishma) characterized by dry, dehydrating solar energy reducing maternal vitality, and Visarga Kala (southern solstice: Varsha, Sharad, Hemanta) characterized by lunar, nourishing, moist energy replenishing Dhatus. Pregnancy care requires counteracting the seasonal Dosha vitiation through specific Ahara and Vihara.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 9 & 10: Environmental seasonal impact on pregnancy: extreme summer heat increases dehydration, oligohydramnios, and preterm uterine irritability; monsoon conditions elevate risks of gastroenteritis, waterborne pathogens (hepatitis E, typhoid), and vector-borne infections (malaria, dengue); cold dry winters exacerbate maternal hypertension.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: In Grishma, Pitta and Vata accumulate; cooling Sheeta-Madhura-Drava Ahara prevents dehydration and preserves amniotic volume. In Varsha, Vata aggravates due to dampness; warm, easily digestible Deepana food protects Mandagni.
red_flags: Heat stroke symptoms (hyperthermia, dizziness, oliguria in summer)
Severe vomiting with high fever in monsoon (viral or bacterial gastroenteritis)
Sudden surge in blood pressure during winter months

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — Daily Dinacharya Foundations for Maternal Health
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: मात्राशी स्यात्। आहाराग्निबलमपेक्षते। तस्मात् सम्यगुपयुञ्जीत मात्रया यथोचितम्। तैलमभ्यङ्गे, व्यायामः, स्नानं च बलवर्धनम्॥
chunks.transliteration: mātrāśī syāt | āhārāgnibalamapekṣate | tasmāt samyagupayuñjīta mātrayā yathocitam | tailamabhyaṅge, vyāyāmaḥ, snānaṁ ca balavardhanam ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: गर्भिणी और प्रत्येक व्यक्ति को अग्निबल के अनुसार उचित मात्रा में भोजन (मात्राशी) करना चाहिए। नित्य तैल अभ्यंग (शरीर पर तेल की मालिश), मृदु व्यायाम/टहलना, सुखोष्ण जल से स्नान और इन्द्रिय स्वच्छता शरीर में बल, कान्ति, वातशमन और उत्तम निद्रा प्रदान करती है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Charaka emphasizes that maternal diet and physical routine must strictly respect individual digestive capacity (Agni Bala). Essential daily regimen components: morning Abhyanga (gentle self-massage with Bala Taila/sesame oil avoiding abdominal compression), lukewarm bath (Snana), oral hygiene, and light walking (Chankramana) to pacify Vata, relieve muscle aches, promote restful sleep, and stabilize maternal energy.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 9 (Antenatal Care): Recommends daily moderate exercise (walking 30 minutes daily), regular sleep hygiene (8 hours nightly plus 1-2 hours rest), comfortable non-restrictive cotton clothing, adequate personal hygiene, and balanced calorie intake (+350 kcal/day in 2nd/3rd trimester).
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Regular Abhyanga prevents Vata aggravation that normally occurs due to progressive uterine distension and ligamentous strain. Lukewarm bath cleanses Sweda Vaha Srotas and promotes circulation.
red_flags: Severe exhaustion, dizziness or palpitations during walking
Calf tenderness or swelling after exercise
Inability to sleep due to severe orthopnea or paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea

chunks.title: Kashyapa Samhita — Medicated Yusha & Bhojya Kalpa for Maternal Digestion
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: यूषस्तु दीपनः पाची रोचनो धातुवर्धनः। मुद्गयूषः प्रशस्तोऽत्र दाडिमामलकैर्युतः। गर्भिण्या मन्दकायाग्नेर्बलकृत् क्लेदनाशनः॥
chunks.transliteration: yūṣastu dīpanaḥ pācī rocano dhātuvardhanaḥ | mudgayūṣaḥ praśasto'tra dāḍimāmalakairyutaḥ | garbhiṇyā mandakāyāgnerbalakṛt kledanāśanaḥ ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: कश्यप के अनुसार यूष (दालों का संस्कृत सूप) गर्भिणी की मन्दाग्नि को प्रदीप्त करने वाला, पाचन करने वाला, रुचिकर और धातुओं का पोषण करने वाला होता है। मूंग का यूष जिसमें अनार (दाडिम) और आंवला सिद्ध किया गया हो, गर्भिणी के लिए सर्वोत्तम है। यह बिना भारीपन किए बल देता है तथा शरीर के क्लेद को सुखाता है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Kashyapa formulates therapeutic medicated lentil broths (Yusha) and culinary recipes (Bhojya Kalpa) specifically customized for sluggish maternal digestive capacity (Mandagni). Green gram soup (Mudga Yusha) processed with pomegranate juice (Dadima Rasa), Amla, cumin (Jeeraka), and ghee provides easily assimilable plant protein, iron, and electrolytes, resolving pregnancy-associated nausea, anorexia, and digestive sluggishness without causing abdominal bloating.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 9 (Maternal Nutrition): Recommends high-protein, easily digestible legumes, split pulses, and broths providing potassium, folate, and iron. Small frequent light liquid and semi-solid meals mitigate first-trimester nausea and late third-trimester gastric reflux.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Mudga is Laghu, Vishada, and Kaphaghna. Combined with Dadima and Ghrita, it rekindles Pachaka Pitta while nourishing Rasa and Rakta Dhatus.
red_flags: Severe food intolerance with ongoing weight loss
Severe epigastric pain or persistent sour vomiting accompanied by hematemesis

chunks.iast: tatra khalv ime garbhopaghātakarā bhāvā bhavanti — mātuś cāhāra-vihāra-viparyayaḥ
chunks.hindi: गर्भ को हानि पहुँचाने वाले भाव — माता के आहार-विहार का विपर्यय, अत्यधिक व्यायाम, शोक, भय, क्रोध आदि।
chunks.english: Ahara (Food) factors to avoid in pregnancy: Katu, Tikshna, Ushna, Atilavana — chilli, pickles, vinegar, very salty or very hot food; Ruksha, Guru, Abhishyandi & fermented foods; stale / packaged / street food (Paryushita); Viruddha Ahara — equal honey + ghee, milk + fish, fruit + milk combinations; Alcohol, tobacco, gutka; excess tea/coffee; raw papaya & large amounts of pineapple; Raw / half-cooked meat & eggs, unpasteurised dairy, raw sprouts (Listeria, Salmonella); Fasting (Upavasa) & prolonged hunger. Classical effects described: Garbhasrava / Garbhapata (abortion), Garbhashosha (IUGR), Upavishtaka (Vata-Pitta stasis), Vikrita-prajanana (congenital anomalies) and Kubja, Kuni, Pangu, Jada in Sushruta (Dauhrida vimanana). Modern correlates: miscarriage, IUGR, neural-tube defects, FAS, preterm labour.

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — Non-Suppression of Natural Urges (Adharaniya Vegas)
chunks.citation: Charaka Samhita, Sharira Sthana 8/21 & Sutra Sthana 7/3-5
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: न वेगान् धारयेद्धीमांस्तान् हि धारयतः पृथक्। दोषाः प्रकुपिताः कुर्युर्विकारान् विविधान् बहून्॥ गर्भिण्या विशेषतो वेगधारणं गर्भोपघातकरम्।
chunks.transliteration: na vegān dhārayeddhīmāṁstān hi dhārayataḥ pṛthak | doṣāḥ prakupitāḥ kuryurvikārān vividhān bahūn || garbhiṇyā viśeṣato vegadhāraṇaṁ garbhopaghātakaram |
chunks.hindi_meaning: बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति को 13 अधारणीय वेगों (मल, मूत्र, अपानवायु, छर्दि, क्षुधा, तृष्णा, निद्रा आदि) को कभी नहीं रोकना चाहिए। गर्भिणी द्वारा वेगों को धारण करने से अपान और प्राण वायु प्रकुपित होकर गर्भाशय में शूल, आक्षेप, गर्भास्राव या गर्भपात उत्पन्न कर सकते हैं।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Charaka strongly condemns suppressing the thirteen natural biological urges (Adharaniya Vegas) including micturition, defecation, flatus, hunger, thirst, sleep, and vomiting. In pregnancy, voluntary suppression of urges is explicitly categorized as Garbhopaghatakara (harmful to pregnancy): holding urine or stool provokes Apana Vata, which moves upward (Udvrita), leading to pelvic pain, tenesmus, uterine irritability, and even threatened abortion.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 18 & 21: Voluntary urinary retention in pregnancy exacerbates urinary stasis caused by progesterone-mediated ureteral dilation, predisposing to acute pyelonephritis and asymptomatic bacteriuria. Severe constipation and chronic straining elevate intra-abdominal pressure and can induce premature contractions.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Apana Vata natural direction is Adhogati. Suppressing Mutra or Purisha causes Pratiloma Vata, transmitting retrograde hydrostatic stress to the uterine walls.
red_flags: Severe dysuria with high fever, chills, and flank pain (Acute Pyelonephritis)
Inability to pass flatus or stool with abdominal distension (Intestinal Obstruction)
Severe uterine cramping following bouts of constipation

chunks.title: Ashtanga Hridaya — Garbhasrava, Garbhapata, Upavishtaka & Nagodara
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: चतुर्थाभ्यन्तरे मासि स्रावः स्याद् गर्भसंप्लवात्। पञ्चमे षष्ठे तु पातः प्रपद्यते। उपविष्टको वातोपद्रुते रसे भवति, नागोदरोऽपि वा॥
chunks.transliteration: caturthābhyantare māsi srāvaḥ syād garbhasaṁplavāt | pañcame ṣaṣṭhe tu pātaḥ prapadyate | upaviṣṭako vātopadrute rase bhavati, nāgodaro'pi vā ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: चौथे महीने तक जब गर्भ तरल रूप में स्रवित होता है, तो उसे 'गर्भस्राव' (miscarriage) कहते हैं; पांचवें या छठे महीने में जब अंग-प्रत्यंग युक्त गर्भ निष्कासित होता है, तो उसे 'गर्भपात' (abortion/immature delivery) कहते हैं। वात के कारण जब माता का रसधातु सूख जाता है और गर्भ की वृद्धि रुक जाती है, तो उसे 'उपविष्टक' (IUGR) और उदर का न बढ़ना 'नागोदर' कहलाता है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Vagbhata provides precise definitions of gestational loss and fetal growth disorders: Loss up to the 4th month is designated Garbhasrava (early spontaneous miscarriage where the conceptus is unformed and liquefied); loss in the 5th and 6th months is designated Garbhapata (fetal expulsion with formed limbs and solid organs). Upavishtaka represents fetal growth faltering due to maternal bleeding or depleted Rasa Dhatu (intrauterine growth restriction); Nagodara represents delayed abdominal enlargement with prolonged quiescent gestation.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 15 (Abortion / Miscarriage) & Ch. 31 (Intrauterine Growth Restriction): Miscarriage is defined as termination of pregnancy before 20-24 weeks. IUGR (fetal weight below 10th percentile for gestational age) is classified into symmetrical (early genetic/infection) and asymmetrical (late uteroplacental insufficiency).
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Vata vitiation dries up the Rasa Dhatu streams flowing to the fetus, causing Upavishtaka. Madhura-Brimhana Dravyas, milk, and rest in left lateral position restore placental perfusion.
red_flags: Fresh red bleeding per vaginam with uterine cramping
Fundal height lagging >3 cm behind gestational dates
Loss of fetal movements for >12 consecutive hours

chunks.title: Kashyapa Samhita — 8 Classical Garbhini Upadravas (Pregnancy Complications)
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: गर्भिण्या जायन्तेऽष्टौ विकारा दारुणा नृणाम्। छर्दिः शोफो ज्वरः कासो श्वासोऽतीसार एव च। पाण्डुश्च विबन्धश्चेति, तान् यत्नेन प्रसाधयेत्॥
chunks.transliteration: garbhiṇyā jāyante'ṣṭau vikārā dāruṇā nṛṇām | chardiḥ śopho jvaraḥ kāso śvāso'tīsāra eva ca | pāṇḍuśca vibandhaśceti, tān yatnena prasādhayet ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: महर्षि कश्यप ने गर्भिणी के आठ दारुण उपद्रवों (गम्भीर जटिलताओं) का वर्णन किया है: १. छर्दि (उल्टी/Nausea), २. शोथ (सूजन/Edema), ३. ज्वर (बुखार/Fever), ४. कास (खांसी/Cough), ५. श्वास (सांस फूलना/Dyspnea), ६. अतीसार (दस्त/Diarrhea), ७. पाण्डु (रक्तअल्पता/Anemia), और ८. विबन्ध (कब्ज/Constipation)। गर्भिणी में तीक्ष्ण शोधन व वमन विरेचन वर्जित होने से इनका मृदु व मधुर औषधियों से उपचार करना चाहिए।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Acharya Kashyapa systematically enumerates the Eight Cardinal Upadravas (systemic complications) of pregnancy: Chhardi (hyperemesis), Shopha (gestational edema / preeclampsia), Jwara (pyrexia in pregnancy), Kasa (respiratory distress/cough), Shwasa (dyspnea/pulmonary compromise), Atisara (gestational gastroenteritis), Pandu (anemia in pregnancy), and Vibandha (severe chronic constipation). Because aggressive bio-cleansing (Panchakarma / Vamana / Virechana) is strictly contraindicated in pregnancy, all maternal complications must be managed with gentle, palliative, non-embryotoxic therapies.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 17, 18, 19, 20 & 21: Direct correspondence to high-risk obstetric conditions: Hyperemesis gravidarum (Chhardi), Hypertensive disorders / Preeclampsia (Shopha), Pyrexia / Chorioamnionitis (Jwara), Anemia in pregnancy (Pandu), and Bowel dysmotility (Vibandha). Standard obstetric protocol requires early risk stratification and hospital referral.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: The growing fetus consumes maternal Rasa and Rakta while mechanically compressing abdominal viscera, weakening Jatharagni and provoking Vata. Aggressive purgatives trigger uterine hypertonicity.
red_flags: Severe headache, blurring of vision, right upper quadrant pain (Impending Eclampsia)
High fever with chills and uterine tenderness (Chorioamnionitis)
Sudden explosive watery diarrhea causing maternal hypovolemia and fetal distress

chunks.sanskrit: दौहृदविमाननाद्वा गर्भोत्पीडनाद्वा वातपित्तप्रकोपात् छर्दिर्जायते
chunks.iast: dauhridavimānanādvā garbhotpīḍanādvā vātapittaprakopāt chardir jāyate
chunks.hindi: दौहृद की उपेक्षा, गर्भ द्वारा आमाशय का संपीडन तथा वात-पित्त प्रकोप से गर्भिणी में छर्दि उत्पन्न होती है।
chunks.english: Garbhini Chhardi arises from neglect of Dauhrida (pregnancy desires), upward anatomical pressure of the expanding uterus on the Amashaya, and Vata-Pitta aggravation. First-line supportive care: Laja-manda (parched rice water) with elaichi & honey, Dadima (pomegranate) juice, Eladi churna with honey, small frequent dry meals. Severe persistent vomiting is a clinical red flag. Symptoms: Severe persistent nausea, intractable vomiting, inability to retain oral fluids or solids, ketonuria, weight loss. Clinical Actions: Sip cool Laja-manda (puffed rice water) or tender coconut water in small frequent sips.; Eat dry carbohydrate snacks (dry toast, roasted makhana, puffed rice) before getting out of bed.; Avoid greasy, spicy, fried, or strongly aromatic foods that trigger nausea.; Seek emergency hospital care immediately if unable to keep liquids down for >12 hours, dark urine, or feeling dizzy.
chunks.citation: Harita Samhita 3.51 (Garbhini Upadrava); Charaka Sha. 8; Sushruta Sha. 10
chunks.dc_dutta: Nausea & vomiting affects 50–70% of pregnant women (morning sickness) due to peak hCG, estrogen and progesterone; intractable vomiting with dehydration, ketonuria, weight loss >5% and electrolyte imbalance defines Hyperemesis Gravidarum (0.5–2% incidence). Management: hospital admission if ketones positive, IV fluid rehydration (Ringer lactate / Normal saline), thiamine 100 mg daily, pyridoxine (Vit B6) 10–25 mg TDS, doxylamine 10–20 mg, metoclopramide or ondansetron.
red_flags: Inability to keep liquids down for 12–24 hours
Rapid weight loss or extreme dizziness / fainting
Dark concentrated urine with sweet fruity ketone odour

plan.name: Garbhini Chhardi (Nausea & Hyperemesis Gravidarum)
plan.symptom: Severe persistent nausea, intractable vomiting, inability to retain oral fluids or solids, ketonuria, weight loss
actions: Sip cool Laja-manda (puffed rice water) or tender coconut water in small frequent sips.
Eat dry carbohydrate snacks (dry toast, roasted makhana, puffed rice) before getting out of bed.
Avoid greasy, spicy, fried, or strongly aromatic foods that trigger nausea.
Seek emergency hospital care immediately if unable to keep liquids down for >12 hours, dark urine, or feeling dizzy.

chunks.sanskrit: गर्भस्पन्दनहानिः गर्भोपरोधं प्राणसंशयं च सूचयति
chunks.iast: garbhaspandanahāniḥ garbhoparodhaṃ prāṇasaṃśayaṃ ca sūcayati
chunks.hindi: गर्भ में स्पन्दन की कमी या अभाव गर्भ के संकट तथा प्राण-संशय का गंभीर लक्षण है।
chunks.english: Garbha Spandana Mandata (cessation or marked reduction of fetal movement) indicates Garbhoparodha (fetal distress, hypoxia, or compromise of Prana). The mother should immediately lie on her left side, take a cool sweet drink, and if movements remain reduced, seek emergency fetal monitoring. Symptoms: Fewer than 10 fetal kicks/movements in 12 hours, sudden drop in usual movement pattern, or no movement felt for >2 hours after meals. Clinical Actions: Lie down immediately on your LEFT side in a quiet room.; Drink a glass of cold water or sweet fruit juice and place your hands on your abdomen for 1 hour.; Count distinct kicks, rolls, and flutters. If fewer than 3 movements in 1 hour or <10 in 12 hours, go to hospital immediately.; Do NOT wait until the next scheduled clinic visit.
chunks.dc_dutta: Fetal movements are a primary indicator of fetal well-being. 'Kick-count' (Cardiff count-to-ten method): mother should perceive ≥10 distinct movements in 12 hours (or ≥3 movements within 1 hour after meals in left lateral rest). Reduced fetal movements (<10/12h or subjective reduction) is associated with uteroplacental insufficiency, oligohydramnios, cord compression, or fetal growth restriction (IUGR). Immediate evaluation required: Non-Stress Test (NST), Modified Biophysical Profile (BPP), and Umbilical Artery Doppler ultrasound.
red_flags: No fetal movement felt all morning or day
Fewer than 10 movements in a 12-hour window
A sudden frantic burst of movements followed by complete cessation
tags: reduced / absent fetal movement (garbha spandana mandata)

chunks.sanskrit: आ चतुर्थात् मासात् स्रवति गर्भो विसर्जितः ततः परं पतति गर्भपातः
chunks.iast: ā caturthān māsāt sravati garbho visarjitaḥ tataḥ paraṃ patati garbhapātaḥ
chunks.hindi: चौथे माह तक गर्भ के निष्कासन को 'गर्भस्राव' तथा पाँचवें-छठे माह में 'गर्भपात' कहते हैं। रक्तस्राव इसका प्रमुख लक्षण है।
chunks.english: Expulsion of the conception product up to the 4th month is Garbhasrava (unformed); from 5th month onwards it is Garbhapata. Vaginal bleeding in any trimester is an acute clinical warning sign requiring absolute physical rest, Garbhasthapaka therapy (Shatavari, Yashtimadhu, Lodhra, Ashoka), and urgent ultrasound evaluation. Symptoms: Any vaginal bleeding, spotting, brown discharge, or clots with or without lower abdominal cramps or backache. Clinical Actions: Rest completely flat in bed immediately; avoid all walking, climbing, and exertion.; Do NOT perform or allow any digital internal/vaginal examination.; Check maternal Rh blood group: Rh-negative mothers need Anti-D Immunoglobulin within 72 hours.; Transport urgently to the nearest obstetric hospital for immediate ultrasound and fetal heart check.
chunks.citation: Charaka Sha. 8.24; Sushruta Sha. 8.10; Ashtanga Hridaya Sha. 2
chunks.dc_dutta: ANY vaginal bleeding in pregnancy is an emergency. 1st Trimester: Threatened abortion, inevitable/incomplete abortion, ectopic pregnancy, or molar pregnancy (needs TVS ultrasound, serum beta-hCG, Rh typing). 2nd & 3rd Trimester: Antepartum Haemorrhage (APH) due to Placenta Praevia (painless bright red bleeding) or Abruptio Placentae (painful dark bleeding with tense woody uterus). NEVER perform a digital vaginal examination. Immediate emergency hospital transfer with IV access.
red_flags: Fresh red bleeding with or without pain
Passage of clots or fleshy tissue PV
Bleeding after 24 weeks gestation (suspected Placenta Praevia / Abruptio)

plan.name: Vaginal Bleeding / Spotting (Garbhasrava / Garbhapata / APH)
plan.symptom: Any vaginal bleeding, spotting, brown discharge, or clots with or without lower abdominal cramps or backache
actions: Rest completely flat in bed immediately; avoid all walking, climbing, and exertion.
Do NOT perform or allow any digital internal/vaginal examination.
Check maternal Rh blood group: Rh-negative mothers need Anti-D Immunoglobulin within 72 hours.
Transport urgently to the nearest obstetric hospital for immediate ultrasound and fetal heart check.

chunks.sanskrit: ज्वरस्तु गर्भिण्याः कष्टतमो भवति गर्भविनाशनः
chunks.iast: jvarastu garbhiṇyāḥ kaṣṭatamo bhavati garbhavināśanaḥ
chunks.hindi: गर्भिणी का ज्वर अत्यंत कष्टप्रद होता है तथा यह गर्भ के लिए हानिकारक एवं विनाशक हो सकता है।
chunks.english: Garbhini Jwara is designated as the most hazardous Upadrava because prolonged high heat (Ushna Virya / Pitta) affects maternal Agni, crosses the placental barrier, and causes Garbhopaghata (fetal tachycardia, oligohydramnios, or miscarriage). Safe paracetamol, cooling lukewarm sponge, Shunthi-Dhanyaka boiled water, and immediate etiology diagnosis are imperative. Symptoms: Maternal body temperature >38 °C (100.4 °F), chills, body ache, shivering, malaise, fetal tachycardia. Clinical Actions: Use lukewarm water sponge over forehead, neck, and limbs to gently bring down temperature.; Take safe Paracetamol under clinician recommendation; NEVER take ibuprofen, aspirin, or unprescribed antibiotics.; Maintain continuous oral hydration with ORS, coconut water, and boiled water.; Consult your obstetrician immediately for blood tests to rule out malaria, dengue, or bacterial infection.
chunks.citation: Harita Samhita 3.50; Charaka Chi. 3; Kashyapa Khila Sthana
chunks.dc_dutta: Maternal pyrexia >38 °C (100.4 °F) increases maternal metabolic rate, leads to maternal dehydration, and elevates fetal baseline heart rate (>160 bpm). Hyperthermia in early pregnancy (1st trimester) is associated with neural tube defects; in late pregnancy, it triggers preterm contractions and chorioamnionitis. Endemic infections like Malaria, Dengue, Hepatitis E, and Typhoid carry markedly higher morbidity and mortality in pregnancy. Immediate full infection workup (CBC, blood smear, dengue NS1/IgM, blood culture, urine culture). Safe antipyretic: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) 500–1000 mg 6-hourly (avoid NSAIDs / aspirin).
red_flags: Temperature >38.5 °C (101.3 °F) or high fever with shivering
Fever accompanied by foul-smelling vaginal discharge or uterine tenderness
Fever with rash, jaundice, or breathlessness

chunks.sanskrit: वातपित्तोद्भवं मूत्रकृच्छ्रं गर्भिण्यां दाहवेदनायुक्तम्
chunks.iast: vātapittodbhavaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ garbhiṇyāṃ dāhavedanāyuktam
chunks.hindi: गर्भिणी में दाह और तीव्र वेदना युक्त मूत्रकृच्छ्र वात-पित्त प्रकोप से उत्पन्न होता है।
chunks.english: Mutrakrichhra in pregnancy is an inflammatory Vata-Pitta disorder of the Mutravaha Srotas. Regimen: Gokshura kwatha/water, barley water (Yava udaka), tender coconut water, coriander seed water (Dhanyaka hima), and strict genital hygiene. Must be investigated for bacterial UTI to prevent ascending pyelonephritis. Symptoms: Pain or burning sensation during urination, increased frequency, urgency, lower abdominal pain, cloudy or foul-smelling urine, fever. Clinical Actions: Drink plenty of fluids: 3 litres of water, coconut water, and barley water daily.; Collect a clean-catch midstream urine sample for routine microscopy and culture-sensitivity test.; Do NOT delay or hold back the urge to urinate (avoid Mutra-vega dharana).; Take prescribed pregnancy-safe antibiotics under doctor supervision; do not stop mid-course.
chunks.citation: Charaka Chi. 26; Sushruta Uttara. 59; Harita Samhita 3
chunks.dc_dutta: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) is the most common bacterial infection in pregnancy (asymptomatic bacteriuria in 2–10%, acute cystitis in 1–2%, acute pyelonephritis in 1–2%). Physiological hydronephrosis and ureteric dilatation caused by progesterone and right-sided dextrorotation of the gravid uterus lead to urinary stasis. Untreated asymptomatic bacteriuria progresses to acute pyelonephritis in 30% of cases and carries high risk of preterm labor and low birth weight. Management: midstream clean-catch urine routine and culture-sensitivity; oral antibiotics (nitrofurantoin, amoxicillin-clavulanate, cephalexin) for 5–7 days; liberal hydration.
red_flags: High fever with chills and shivering
Loin pain or severe flank tenderness (suspected Acute Pyelonephritis)
Visible blood in urine (hematuria)

chunks.sanskrit: गर्भाहारपोषणात् मातुः रसादीनां क्षये पाण्डुत्वमापद्यते
chunks.iast: garbhāhārapoṣaṇāt mātuḥ rasādīnāṃ kṣaye pāṇḍutvam āpadyate
chunks.hindi: गर्भ के सतत पोषण से माता के रस-रक्त धातुओं का क्षय होकर पाण्डु रोग (एनीमिया) होता है।
chunks.english: Garbhini Pandu occurs because the growing Garbha continuously extracts Rasa and Rakta Dhatu from the mother. The mother exhibits Vivarnata (paleness), Daurbalya (weakness), and Hrid-drava (palpitations). Regimen: Draksha, Dadima, Kharjura (dates), beetroot, spinach, amla, and classical supervised formulations (Dhatri Lauha, Punarnava Mandura). Symptoms: Extreme fatigue, paleness of conjunctiva/palms/tongue, breathlessness on mild exertion, dizziness, palpitations. Clinical Actions: Check complete blood count (CBC) and serum ferritin levels with your doctor.; Take iron-folic acid supplements 2 hours after meals with vitamin C rich fruits (amla, oranges, sweet lime) to maximize absorption.; Do NOT drink tea, coffee, or milk with iron supplements as calcium and tannins inhibit iron absorption.; Include dates, soaked raisins, cooked spinach, pomegranate, and beetroot in daily diet.
chunks.citation: Kashyapa Samhita, Khila Sthana — Garbhini Chikitsa; Charaka Chi. 16
chunks.dc_dutta: Anemia in pregnancy is defined by WHO as Haemoglobin <11.0 g/dl in 1st & 3rd trimester (<10.5 g/dl in 2nd trimester). Physiological hemodilution occurs as maternal plasma volume expands by 50% while RBC mass increases by only 25–30%. Severity grading: Mild (10–10.9 g/dl), Moderate (7–9.9 g/dl), Severe (<7 g/dl), Decompensated / Very Severe (<4 g/dl). Risks: maternal heart failure, preterm labor, PPH, sepsis, low birth weight (LBW). Prophylaxis: 100 mg elemental iron + 500 mcg folic acid for 100 days from 14 weeks. Severe anemia requires parenteral IV iron (ferric carboxymaltose) or packed RBC transfusion.
red_flags: Hemoglobin < 7 g/dl
Shortness of breath even while resting or lying flat
Chest pain, irregular heartbeat, or fainting spells

plan.name: Garbhini Pandu (Antenatal Anemia)
plan.symptom: Extreme fatigue, paleness of conjunctiva/palms/tongue, breathlessness on mild exertion, dizziness, palpitations
actions: Check complete blood count (CBC) and serum ferritin levels with your doctor.
Take iron-folic acid supplements 2 hours after meals with vitamin C rich fruits (amla, oranges, sweet lime) to maximize absorption.
Do NOT drink tea, coffee, or milk with iron supplements as calcium and tannins inhibit iron absorption.
Include dates, soaked raisins, cooked spinach, pomegranate, and beetroot in daily diet.

chunks.sanskrit: शिरःशूलं भ्रमो दृष्टिदोषश्च गर्भिण्यां वातपित्तप्रकोपात् महाभयङ्करः
chunks.iast: śiraḥśūlaṃ bhramo dṛṣṭidoṣaśca garbhiṇyāṃ vātapittaprakopāt mahābhayaṅkaraḥ
chunks.hindi: गर्भिणी में तीव्र शिरःशूल, भ्रम तथा दृष्टिदोष वात-पित्त के उग्र प्रकोप से उत्पन्न महाभयंकर उपद्रव हैं।
chunks.english: Severe Shirahshoola with visual disturbances and epigastric burning indicates critical Pitta-Vata vitiation affecting the Shiras and Hridaya. In modern obstetrics, this represents cerebral vasospasm and impending eclampsia. Symptoms: Severe persistent frontal or occipital headache, blurred vision, flashes of light, scotomata, epigastric or right hypochondriac pain. Clinical Actions: Go directly to the nearest maternity hospital emergency room immediately.; Do NOT take unprescribed painkillers or sleep pills; do NOT wait for symptoms to pass.; Keep the patient in a quiet, dimly lit room and transport in a left lateral position.
chunks.citation: Kashyapa Samhita, Khila Sthana — Garbhini Chikitsa; Harita Samhita 3
chunks.dc_dutta: Severe persistent headache not relieved by paracetamol, visual disturbances (blurring, scotomata, flashes of light, blindness), and epigastric or right upper quadrant pain (hepatic capsular distension) are classic premonitory symptoms of IMPENDING ECLAMPSIA. Critical obstetric emergency: requires immediate admission, loading dose of Magnesium Sulphate (Pritchard or Zuspan regimen), IV antihypertensives (Labetalol / Hydralazine), and emergency delivery planning.
red_flags: Throbbing headache not responding to simple analgesics
Spots in front of eyes or loss of vision
Pain below the right ribs or under the breastbone
Hyperreflexia or muscular twitching / convulsions

chunks.sanskrit: गर्भातिवृद्ध्या रसवाहिनीनां संरोधात् वातेन शोफः पादयोर्जायते
chunks.iast: garbhātivṛddhyā rasavāhinīnāṃ saṃrodhāt vātena śophaḥ pādayor jāyate
chunks.hindi: गर्भ की अत्यधिक वृद्धि से रसवाहिनियों के अवरोध तथा वात प्रकोप से गर्भिणी के चरणों में शोफ (सूजन) होती है।
chunks.english: Garbhini Shopha occurs when the gravid uterus causes mechanical pressure on venous return (Rasavaha/Raktavaha srotorodha), creating Vata stasis and fluid retention. Mild dependent pedal edema at evening is physiological; swelling extending to the face, hands, or abdomen, or accompanied by elevated BP, is pathological. Symptoms: Sudden or rapid swelling of feet, ankles, face, eyelids and fingers; tight rings; sudden weight gain (>1 kg/week). Clinical Actions: Elevate legs above heart level for 15–20 minutes twice daily; avoid prolonged standing or sitting with dangling legs.; Sleep strictly in the left lateral position to relieve inferior vena cava compression.; Check blood pressure immediately at a clinic; never restrict water intake (maintain 2.5–3 L/day).; Report immediately if swelling is accompanied by headache, visual blurring, or epigastric pain.
chunks.citation: Harita Samhita 3.52; Charaka Sha. 8; Sushruta Sha. 10
chunks.dc_dutta: Physiological dependent ankle edema occurs in ~80% of pregnant women. Pathological edema (present upon rising in the morning, involving hands and face, or rapid weight gain >1 kg/week) is a cardinal sign of Pre-eclampsia (defined as BP ≥140/90 mmHg on two occasions 4 hours apart after 20 weeks with proteinuria ≥1+ on dipstick). Emergency evaluation required: CBC, LFT, serum creatinine, urine protein:creatinine ratio, and fetal NST/Doppler.
red_flags: Facial, eyelid or hand swelling on waking
Blood pressure ≥140/90 mmHg
Swelling with headache, blurred vision, or upper abdominal pain

chunks.sanskrit: गर्भप्रस्रवे गर्भोदकनिर्गमे गर्भोपरोधः सूतिकाले च संशयः
chunks.iast: garbhaprasrave garbhodakanirgame garbhoparodhaḥ sūtikāle ca saṃśayaḥ
chunks.hindi: समय से पूर्व गर्भोदक (एम्नियोटिक द्रव) के निकल जाने से गर्भ में संकोच, संक्रमण तथा संकट होता है।
chunks.english: Premature rupture and leaking of amniotic fluid (Garbhodaka Srava) compromises the fluid cushion around the fetus, exposes the uterine cavity to ascending infection, and precipitates preterm delivery. Symptoms: Sudden gush or continuous trickling of watery fluid from the vagina before 37 weeks, distinct from urine. Clinical Actions: Go immediately to the maternity labor room; wear a clean sanitary pad to assess fluid color and amount.; Do NOT insert tampons, do NOT have sexual intercourse, and do NOT take a bath in a tub.; Check whether fluid is clear, greenish (meconium stained), or has a foul odor.; Lie down during transport to minimize fluid loss and risk of umbilical cord prolapse.
chunks.dc_dutta: Preterm Premature Rupture of Membranes (PPROM): rupture of chorioamniotic membranes before 37 completed weeks of gestation. Diagnosis: sterile speculum examination showing pooling of clear fluid in posterior vaginal fornix; Nitrazine paper test turns blue (alkaline pH >6.5); Fern test positive under microscope. Risks: ascending chorioamnionitis, cord prolapse, abruptio placentae, oligohydramnios, neonatal sepsis, respiratory distress syndrome (RDS). Management: emergency hospital admission, maternal temperature and vitals monitoring, prophylactic antibiotics (Erythromycin / Ampicillin), antenatal corticosteroid (Betamethasone 12 mg IM 2 doses 24h apart) for fetal lung maturation if <34 weeks, fetal monitoring.
red_flags: Continuous uncontrollable leaking of warm clear or pinkish fluid
Fluid has a green, brown, or foul-smelling appearance
Leaking accompanied by fever or regular lower back contractions

chunks.sanskrit: गर्भापीडितकोष्ठत्वात् वातस्य विलोमत्वात् विबन्धो भवति
chunks.iast: garbhāpīḍitakoṣṭhatvāt vātasya vilomatvāt vibandho bhavati
chunks.hindi: गर्भ के भार से कोष्ठ के दबने तथा अपान वात के प्रतिलोम होने से गर्भिणी को विबन्ध (कब्ज) होता है।
chunks.english: Garbhini Vibandha arises from anatomical pressure of the expanding fetus upon the Pakvashaya (colon) and physiological upward vitiation (Vilomatva) of Apana Vata. Classical treatment: Warm cow's milk with 1–2 teaspoons of pure cow ghee at night, soaked Munakka (black raisins), high-fiber dietary grains (Dalia, oats, whole wheat), and avoiding harsh purgatives. Symptoms: Infrequent hard dry stools (<3 bowel movements/week), painful defecation, abdominal bloating, rectal bleeding or piles. Clinical Actions: Drink 1 cup of warm boiled cow's milk with 1–2 tsp of cow's ghee at bedtime.; Eat 8–10 soaked black raisins (Munakka) with warm water in the early morning.; Increase fluid intake to 2.5–3 litres daily and consume whole grains and cooked vegetables.; Never strain at stool; consult doctor if there is fresh rectal bleeding or severe hemorrhoidal pain.
chunks.citation: Charaka Sha. 8; Ashtanga Hridaya Sha. 2; Sushruta Sha. 10
chunks.dc_dutta: Constipation affects ~40% of pregnant women due to progesterone-mediated smooth muscle relaxation delaying colonic transit time, mechanical compression of the rectosigmoid junction by the gravid uterus, and the astringent side-effect of oral iron supplements. Straining at stool exacerbates hemorrhoids (piles) and pelvic floor weakness. Management: high dietary fiber (25–30 g/day), liberal water intake (2.5–3 L/day), physical activity, stool bulkers (Ispaghula husk / Psyllium) or osmotic laxatives (lactulose). AVOID stimulant laxatives (senna, castor oil) which can provoke uterine contractions.
red_flags: Severe abdominal pain with complete inability to pass flatus or stool (intestinal obstruction)
Persistent bright red rectal bleeding with defecation
Protruding thrombosed painful hemorrhoidal mass

chunks.title: Sushruta Samhita — Mudha Garbha Nidana (Obstructed Labor & Malpresentations)
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: यदा तु गर्भो वायुना प्रतिहतगतिः तिर्यक् सङ्गतो वा विवृत्तशिरा वा द्वारं रुणद्धि, स मूढगर्भ इत्युच्यते। कीलकः प्रतिखुरो बीजः परिघश्चेति चतुर्विधः॥
chunks.transliteration: yadā tu garbho vāyunā pratihatagatiḥ tiryak saṅgato vā vivṛttaśirā vā dvāraṁ ruṇaddhi, sa mūḍhagarbha ityucyate | kīlakaḥ pratikhuro bījaḥ parighaśceti caturvidhaḥ ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: जब प्रकुपित अपान वायु के कारण गर्भ की स्वाभाविक अधोगति अवरुद्ध हो जाती है और वह तिरछा, उल्टे सिर या हाथ-पैर फैलाकर गर्भाशय मुख को अवरुद्ध कर देता है, तो उसे 'मूढगर्भ' (obstructed labor / dystocia) कहते हैं। इसके मुख्य प्रकार हैं: कीलक, प्रतिखुर, बीज और परिघ।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Sushruta's foundational treatise on obstetric dystocia: When Apana Vata becomes pathologically deranged or mechanical cephalopelvic disproportion (CPD) exists, the fetal axis becomes deflected into abnormal presentations (transverse lie, brow, shoulder presentation, compound presentation). He classifies the four classical presentations of Mudha Garbha: Kilaka (impacted longitudinal presentation), Pratikhura (compound presentation with hands and feet prolapsing), Bija (transverse shoulder presentation), and Parigha (transverse lie obstructing pelvic inlet like a crossbar).
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 24 & 25 (Malposition, Malpresentation & Obstructed Labor): Transverse lie, breech presentation, shoulder dystocia, and cephalopelvic disproportion. Maternal exhaustion, uterine rupture risk (Bandl's retraction ring), and fetal hypoxia mandate immediate emergency operative delivery (Cesarean section).
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Deranged Apana Vata causes dyssynergic uterine contractions, preventing normal cervical dilatation and head flexion.
red_flags: Pathological retraction ring of Bandl visible on maternal abdomen
Fetal bradycardia (<110 bpm) or variable/late decelerations
Maternal dehydration, rising pulse >110 bpm, and tender lower uterine segment

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — Sutika Paricharya (Puerperal Rejuvenation Protocol)
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: प्रजातायाश्च गर्भाशये विशुद्धे स्नेहमिश्रामौषधियुक्तां यवागूं पाययेत्। उदरवेष्टनं च कुर्याद् वस्त्रेण, वातप्रशमनाय गर्भाशयसंकोचनाय च॥
chunks.transliteration: prajātāyāśca garbhāśaye viśuddhe snehamiśrāmauṣadhiyuktāṁ yavāgūṁ pāyayet | udaraveṣṭanaṁ ca kuryād vastreṇa, vātapraśamanāya garbhāśayasaṁkocanāya ca ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: प्रसव के उपरांत जब अपरा निर्गमन से गर्भाशय विशुद्ध हो जाए, तब सूतिका को बला तैल से अभ्यंग एवं उष्णोदक परिषेक कराएं। अग्निदीपन हेतु पिप्पल्यादि या पञ्चकोल चूर्ण से सिद्ध स्नेहमिश्रित यवागू (पतला दलिया/सूप) पिलाएं। शिथिल उदर में वायु के अवकाश को रोकने तथा गर्भाशय के संकोच (involution) हेतु उदर को स्वच्छ सूती वस्त्र से लपेटें (उदरवेष्टन)।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Following expulsion of the placenta (Apara), maternal Dhatus are deeply depleted (Dhatu-Rikta) and Vata is severely provoked in the evacuated uterine cavity. Charaka prescribes warm medicated oil Abhyanga, Parisheka with warm decoctions, digestive Yavagu medicated with Panchakola or Pippalyadi Churna to rekindle Jatharagni, and Udaraveshtana (firm abdominal wrapping with clean cotton cloth) to prevent Vata accumulation and expedite physiological uterine involution.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 13 (The Normal Puerperium): Puerperium encompasses the 6 weeks following delivery during which the reproductive organs revert back to their non-pregnant state. Uterine involution progresses at ~1.25 cm daily; uterine tone is crucial to prevent postpartum hemorrhage (PPH); abdominal wall laxity benefits from non-constricting support and gradual pelvic floor rehabilitation.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: The empty pelvic cavity creates Rikta Srotas where Vata instantly accumulates. Snehapana and Panchakola Yavagu rekindle Agni, digest Ama, and soothe Vata, preventing Sutika Jwara and Shoola.
red_flags: Excessive bleeding soaking >1 pad an hour (Postpartum Hemorrhage - PPH)
Foul-smelling lochia accompanied by maternal fever >100.4°F (Puerperal Sepsis)
Calf pain, unilateral leg swelling and warmth (Deep Vein Thrombosis - DVT)

chunks.title: Kashyapa Samhita — Stanya Pariksha (Breast Milk Evaluation) & Galactagogues
chunks.citation: Kashyapa Samhita, Sutra Sthana, Stanya Nirdesha
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: यत् क्षीरमुदके क्षिप्तमेकीभवति पाण्डुरम्। मधुरं चाविवर्णं च तच्छुद्धमिति निर्दिशेत्। धात्र्यास्तु स्तन्यजननं शतावरीक्षीरपानम्॥
chunks.transliteration: yat kṣīramudake kṣiptamekībhavati pāṇḍuram | madhuraṁ cāvivarṇaṁ ca tacchuddhamiti nirdiśet | dhātryāstu stanyajananaṁ śatāvarīkṣīrapānam ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: कश्यप के अनुसार शुद्ध मातृदुग्ध की परीक्षा यह है कि जल में डालने पर वह तुरंत एकीभाव (घुल) हो जाता है, फेन या तंतु नहीं बनाता, श्वेत-पाण्डुर वर्ण, शीतल और मधुर रसयुक्त होता है। स्तनों में दूध की कमी (स्तन्यक्षय) होने पर शतावरी, विदारीकन्द, यष्टिमधु, लहसुन और क्षीर-यवागु का सेवन स्तन्यजनन (galactagogue) होता है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Kashyapa details the clinical diagnostic criteria for human breast milk purity (Stanya Pariksha): When dropped into clear water, wholesome breast milk dissolves homogeneously without floating on top (which indicates Vataja Dushti), discoloring yellow/red (Pittaja), or forming thick sinking phlegm (Kaphaja). In maternal hypogalactia (Stanyakshaya), he prescribes powerful herbal galactagogues (Stanyajanana Mahakashaya): Shatavari, Vidarikanda, Yashtimadhu, Garlic (Lashuna), and medicated cow's milk soups.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 29 & WHO Infant Feeding Guidelines: Composition of mature human milk: 88% water, 7% lactose, 3.8% fat, and 0.9% protein with human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs). Adequate maternal hydration, frequent infant suckling stimulating prolactin and oxytocin let-down reflexes, and supportive galactagogues enhance lactation volume.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Stanya is the Upadhatu of Rasa Dhatu. Soumanasya (maternal happiness) and adequate hydration directly trigger the reflex release of Stanya. Anxiety and anger provoke Vata and Pitta, arresting milk letdown.
red_flags: Severe infant dehydration (depressed fontanelle, dry mucous membranes, <6 wet diapers in 24 hours)
Total cessation of lactation accompanied by high postpartum fever (Sheehan syndrome / severe sepsis)
