chunks.sanskrit: यत् क्षीरमुदके क्षिप्तमेकीभवति पाण्डुरम्। मधुरं चाविवर्णं च तच्छुद्धमिति निर्दिशेत्। धात्र्यास्तु स्तन्यजननं शतावरीक्षीरपानम्॥
chunks.iast: yat kṣīramudake kṣiptamekībhavati pāṇḍuram | madhuraṁ cāvivarṇaṁ ca tacchuddhamiti nirdiśet | dhātryāstu stanyajananaṁ śatāvarīkṣīrapānam ||
chunks.hindi: कश्यप के अनुसार शुद्ध मातृदुग्ध की परीक्षा यह है कि जल में डालने पर वह तुरंत एकीभाव (घुल) हो जाता है, फेन या तंतु नहीं बनाता, श्वेत-पाण्डुर वर्ण, शीतल और मधुर रसयुक्त होता है। स्तनों में दूध की कमी (स्तन्यक्षय) होने पर शतावरी, विदारीकन्द, यष्टिमधु, लहसुन और क्षीर-यवागु का सेवन स्तन्यजनन (galactagogue) होता है।
chunks.english: Kashyapa details the clinical diagnostic criteria for human breast milk purity (Stanya Pariksha): When dropped into clear water, wholesome breast milk dissolves homogeneously without floating on top (which indicates Vataja Dushti), discoloring yellow/red (Pittaja), or forming thick sinking phlegm (Kaphaja). In maternal hypogalactia (Stanyakshaya), he prescribes powerful herbal galactagogues (Stanyajanana Mahakashaya): Shatavari, Vidarikanda, Yashtimadhu, Garlic (Lashuna), and medicated cow's milk soups.
chunks.dc_dutta: DC Dutta Ch. 29 & WHO Infant Feeding Guidelines: Composition of mature human milk: 88% water, 7% lactose, 3.8% fat, and 0.9% protein with human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs). Adequate maternal hydration, frequent infant suckling stimulating prolactin and oxytocin let-down reflexes, and supportive galactagogues enhance lactation volume.

chunks.title: Sushruta Samhita — Puerperal Mastitis & Stanavidradhi (Breast Abscess)
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: क्षीरदोषात् स्तने गाढे दुष्टे रक्तेऽनिलान्विते। जायते स्तनकीलस्तु विद्रधिर्वा भवेत्ततः। पक्वे पाटनमेवेष्टं स्तनसंरक्षणं यथा॥
chunks.transliteration: kṣīradoṣāt stane gāḍhe duṣṭe rakte'nilānvite | jāyate stanakīlastu vidradhirvā bhavettataḥ | pakve pāṭanameveṣṭaṁ stanasaṁrakṣaṇaṁ yathā ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: स्तन में दूध का जमाव (milk stasis) होने तथा दूषित रक्त व वायु के प्रकुपित होने से स्तनकील (breast engorgement) और बाद में स्तनाविवद्रधि (breast abscess) उत्पन्न होती है। पक्व अवस्था में स्तन नलिकाओं (lactiferous ducts) की सुरक्षा करते हुए अरीय चीरा (radial incision) लगाकर पूय (pus) निकालना आवश्यक है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Sushruta documents the surgical pathology of puerperal breast diseases: milk engorgement (Stanakila) progressing to acute mastitis and deep breast abscess (Stanavidradhi). He establishes the fundamental surgical maxim that any incision on the lactating breast must be strictly radial (Arīya Chhedana), following the natural trajectory of lactiferous ducts to avoid ductal transection, milk fistulae, and glandular necrosis.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 29 (Puerperal Disorders — Breast Complications): Acute mastitis (usually Staphylococcus aureus from neonatal nasopharynx) starts with engorgement and cracked nipple; if untreated within 48 hours, it forms a fluctuant breast abscess requiring ultrasound-guided aspiration or surgical drainage via radial incision under general anesthesia.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Stanyarodha (milk stasis) causes Rakta and Pitta vitiation. Continued breastfeeding or expression from the unaffected breast prevents bilateral engorgement.
red_flags: Fluctuant, extremely tender, erythematous breast mass with high spiking fever (>102°F) and rigors
Purulent drainage from nipple
Cracked bleeding nipples with severe agony during infant latching

chunks.sanskrit: प्रसूतां स्नेहं पाययेत् पिप्पलीपिप्पलीमूलचव्यचित्रकशुण्ठीभिः
chunks.iast: prasūtāṃ snehaṃ pāyayet pippalī-pippalīmūla-cavya-citraka-śuṇṭhībhiḥ
chunks.hindi: प्रसव के बाद पिप्पली, पिप्पलीमूल, चव्य, चित्रक, शुण्ठी से सिद्ध स्नेह (घृत/तैल) का सेवन कराएँ।
chunks.english: After delivery give Sneha (ghee/oil) processed with Panchakola (Pippali, Pippalimula, Chavya, Chitraka, Shunthi) to restore Agni and Vata. Dose: 15–30 ml warm ghee/Taila with Panchakola on day 1–3; continued as Snehapana/Yavagu under physician for 3–7 days.
chunks.citation: Ch. Sha. 8.50–51; Su. Chi. 18 ; A.H. Sha. 1 (Sutika)
chunks.dc_dutta: Puerperium & Lactation (6 weeks): Puerperium = from delivery of placenta to 6 weeks. Uterine involution (fundus descends ~1 cm/day; non-palpable per abdomen by day 10–14), lochia: rubra (days 1–4) → serosa (5–9) → alba (10–15+). Exclusive breastfeeding for 6 months, initiate within 1 hour; extra 500 kcal/day; iron + folic acid 100 days post-partum, calcium 500 mg BD for 6 months. Postnatal visits: within 24 h, day 3, day 7, week 6; LAM and contraception counselling; postnatal exercises (Kegel, pelvic tilt).
red_flags: Postpartum haemorrhage — soaking >1 pad/hr, clots, dizziness
Fever >38 °C, foul lochia, lower-abdominal pain (puerperal sepsis)
Breast engorgement/mastitis, cracked nipples, breast abscess
Calf pain or swelling, breathlessness (DVT / PE)
Severe headache / BP rise (postpartum eclampsia)
Persistent low mood, anxiety, thoughts of self-harm (postpartum depression)
C-section wound redness, discharge, dehiscence

chunks.title: Ashtanga Hridaya — Immediate Care of the Newborn & Stanyapana Rules
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: अथातुरमुल्वात् परिमार्ज्य सैन्धवसर्पिषा। प्राणानागतं तावद्विधूनयेत्। नाभिं बध्नीयात्। ततो दक्षिणेन स्तनाग्रं प्रक्षाल्य पाययेत्॥
chunks.transliteration: athāturamulvāt parimārjya saindhavasarpiṣā | prāṇānāgataṁ tāvadvidhūnayet | nābhiṁ badhnīyāt | tato dakṣiṇena stanāgraṁ prakṣālya pāyayet ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: जन्म के तुरंत बाद नवजात शिशु के मुख और तालु से उल्ब का परिमार्जन सैन्धव और घृत से करें। जब तक श्वास भलीभांति न आए, तब तक पंखे से हवा देकर व स्पर्श से प्राण प्रत्यागमन करें। नाभि को सूत्र से बांधकर काटें। माता के दाहिने स्तन को प्रक्षालित कर शिशु को तत्काल प्रथम दुग्ध (कोलोस्ट्रम/पीयूष) का पान कराएं।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Vagbhata's step-by-step neonatal resuscitation and care: Gentle clearance of airway secretions using rock salt and ghee, physical thermal stimulation until regular spontaneous crying occurs, sterile umbilical cord ligation, and washing the maternal nipple followed by immediate initiation of breastfeeding from the right breast. Colostrum (Piyusha) is treated as indispensable for infant longevity and immunity.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 38 (Care of the Newborn): Highlights immediate initiation of exclusive breastfeeding within 1 hour of birth. Colostrum is rich in secretory IgA antibodies, lactoferrin, and maternal leukocytes, providing critical mucosal immunity against neonatal sepsis, necrotizing enterocolitis, and hypothermia.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Colostrum rekindles infant Jatharagni (Dipana) and acts as mild purgative to clear meconium from the newborn intestines.
red_flags: Newborn inability to suckle or maintain latch
Hypothermia (axillary temperature <36.5°C)
Jaundice appearing within the first 24 hours of life (Pathological Jaundice)

chunks.english: Vagbhata's step-by-step neonatal resuscitation and care: Gentle clearance of airway secretions using rock salt and ghee, physical thermal stimulation until regular spontaneous crying occurs, sterile umbilical cord ligation, and washing the maternal nipple followed by immediate initiation of breastfeeding from the right breast. Colostrum (Piyusha) is treated as indispensable for infant longevity and immunity.
chunks.dc_dutta: DC Dutta Ch. 38 (Care of the Newborn): Highlights immediate initiation of exclusive breastfeeding within 1 hour of birth. Colostrum is rich in secretory IgA antibodies, lactoferrin, and maternal leukocytes, providing critical mucosal immunity against neonatal sepsis, necrotizing enterocolitis, and hypothermia.

chunks.title: Charaka Samhita — Navajata Shishu Jatakarma & Resuscitation
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: तत्र जातमात्रस्यैवोल्वे परिमार्जनीये सैन्धवसर्पिषा। ततः प्राणाप्रत्यागमने सति कर्णमूलेऽश्मनोः संघट्टनं, शीतोदकेनोष्णोदकेन वा मुखपरिषेकः। नाडीं चाष्टविंशत्यङ्गुले बद्ध्वा छिन्द्यात्॥
chunks.transliteration: tatra jātamātrasyaivolve parimārjanīye saindhavasarpiṣā | tataḥ prāṇāpratyāgamane sati karṇamūle'śmanoḥ saṁghaṭṭanaṁ, śītodakenoṣṇodakena vā mukhapariṣekaḥ | nāḍīṁ cāṣṭaviṁśatyaṅgule baddhvā chindyāt ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: जन्म लेते ही नवजात शिशु के मुख और तालु से उल्ब (amniotic vernix/mucus) को सैन्धव लवण एवं घृत से स्वच्छ करें। यदि शिशु श्वास न ले रहा हो (प्राणप्रत्यागमन), तो दोनों कानों के पास पत्थरों को टकराकर शब्द करें, मुख पर शीतोष्ण जल छिड़कें। इसके पश्चात नाभि से 8 अंगुल नापकर नाभि-नाड़ी को सूत्र से बांधकर काटें और सुवर्ण-मधु-सर्पि का प्राशन (जातकर्म) कराएं।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Immediate newborn management according to Charaka includes: Ulva Parimarjana (gentle clearance of mucus and vernix from oral and pharyngeal cavities using rock salt and ghee), Pranapratyagamana (auditory and cutaneous tactile stimulation for neonatal resuscitation if breathing is delayed), Nalakartana (umbilical cord clamping and sterile transaction measured at 8 Angulas), and Jatakarma (administering micro-doses of purified gold bhasma with unequal honey and ghee for intellect and vitality).
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 38 (The Newborn Infant): Immediate neonatal care: clearing airway secretions gently without aggressive suctioning, assessment of breathing and APGAR score at 1 and 5 minutes, tactile stimulation, delayed cord clamping (1-3 minutes to allow placental transfusion of 80-100 ml blood), hypothermia prevention via immediate skin-to-skin contact and thermal drying.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Ulva (mucus) obstructs Prana Vaha Srotas. Gentle clearing clears the airway without mucosal trauma. Madhu-Sarpi with gold calx acts as Rasayana to stimulate digestion and innate immunity.
red_flags: Apnea, gasping respiration or central cyanosis at 1 minute
Heart rate <100 bpm requiring bag-and-mask positive pressure ventilation
Bleeding from umbilical cord stump or purulent discharge (Omphalitis)

chunks.title: Kashyapa Samhita — Swarna Prashana Protocol for Pediatric Vitality
chunks.sanskrit_shloka: सुवर्णं मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां लेहयेत् कनकशिशुम्। मेधाग्निबलवर्धनम्, आयुष्यं मङ्गलं पुण्यं ग्रहापहम्। मासात् परममेधावी व्याधिभिर्न च धृष्यते॥
chunks.transliteration: suvarṇaṁ madhusarpirbhyāṁ lehaye kanakaśiśum | medhāgnibalavardhanam, āyuṣyaṁ maṅgalaṁ puṇyaṁ grahāpaham | māsāt paramamedhāvī vyādhibhirna ca dhṛṣyate ||
chunks.hindi_meaning: महर्षि कश्यप (कौमारभृत्य के मूर्धन्य आचार्य) के अनुसार नवजात शिशु को शुद्ध सुवर्ण भस्म को मधु और घृत (विषम मात्रा) के साथ घिसकर चटाना चाहिए। यह सुवर्णप्राशन शिशु की मेधा (बुद्धि), अग्नि (पाचन), बल और आयु की वृद्धि करता है, तथा रोगों और संक्रामक व्याधियों से रक्षा करता है।
chunks.english_clinical_summary: Acharya Kashyapa (the patron authority of Kaumarabhritya / Pediatrics) institutes the classical protocol of Swarna Prashana: micro-quantities of purified, calcined gold (Swarna Bhasma) triturated with unpasteurized honey and aged cow's ghee in unequal ratios. Administered daily, it enhances cognitive faculties (Medha), digestive and metabolic fire (Agni), physical stamina (Bala), somatic longevity (Ayushya), and non-specific immunomodulatory resistance against pediatric infections.
chunks.dc_dutta_correlation: DC Dutta Ch. 38 & Nelson Pediatrics: Corresponds to infant immunomodulation and neurodevelopmental stimulation. Safe complementary pediatric interventions support innate immune priming, enzymatic activation, and trace mineral assimilation during the critical first 1,000 days of life.
chunks.samprapti_yukti: Gold calx is non-toxic, biocompatible, and acts directly on the Ojas and Majja Dhatu, enhancing synaptic neuroplasticity and systemic immune homeostasis.
red_flags: Administration of raw or unpurified heavy metals (must only be standard Ayurvedic pharmacopoeia Swarna Bhasma)
Infant with neonatal hyperbilirubinemia or sepsis requiring active NICU management

chunks.sanskrit: जातमात्रस्य उल्वपरिमार्जनं कर्तव्यम् — मुखनासास्रोतांसि शोधयेत्
chunks.iast: jātamātrasya ulvaparimārjanaṃ kartavyam — mukhanāsāsrotāṃsi śodhayet
chunks.hindi: जन्म लेते ही शिशु के मुख-नासा आदि से उल्व (गर्भोदक/कफ) को साफ़ करें।
chunks.english: Wipe vernix, amniotic fluid and mucus from the face, mouth and nostrils with clean soft cotton to clear the airway.
chunks.dc_dutta: Dry & stimulate (rub back/feet); suction only if airway obstructed; place on mother’s chest skin-to-skin (Initial steps of NRP — first 30 s).
red_flags: Not feeding well / refusing breast
Fast breathing (>60/min), grunting, chest indrawing, central cyanosis
Fever >37.5 °C or hypothermia <36.5 °C
Jaundice within 24 h or reaching palms/soles
Convulsions, lethargy, floppy baby
Cord stump redness/pus, umbilical discharge
No urine in 24 h or no meconium within 48 h

chunks.iast: prathamaṃ stanyaṃ mātrā deyaṃ yathākālaṃ

chunks.english: Early suckling with colostrum — Sushruta/Kashyapa advise first Stanya after proper purification; colostrum is the baby’s first immunisation.
chunks.citation: Su. Sha. 10.18; Kashyapa Sa., Kalpa/Sutra Sthana
chunks.dc_dutta: Breastfeed within 1 h; exclusive breastfeeding to 6 months; on-demand 8–12 feeds/day; correct latch; rooming-in.

Fever >37.5 °C or hypothermia <36.5 °C
